## Texas Hemp THC Ban Takes Effect
Texas' ban on most hemp-derived THC products [took effect Friday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGy2yAURL8GdXjgAhIUFGnUvbQpNQguFpNr4QFiPf99xvmF1Luzs-f8-tq-QqFy3n-GB_rxnet24tUJx8C2vQNRHw1x3Ct2Ki9slQhb3EDAzIXlQm0pFHpvekp-F8nJCb1crFmMdiCnwyewYcnaBrUra3Wal6wWLQPYaGYDair-MyasUFIKEOI2Q3AqySxRBeNSZlpgKqO22zhw4Hfomd71he0W62Mif4zx7Ez9YLAyWK_ruv3Gs5tPymANbZRIyGD9gDFYqcZADNZxRN6wj1biKPXs_MDHk-9_ejmxd_xUwRquMoLSgNzsYeE674I7tyTupNFKoM3RzVPz6XkVotLnhWlxf4RC_96N_3P68vA3AAD__84DiV0), pulling delta-8, delta-10, and THCA flower off store shelves statewide. The ban stems from a [Texas Supreme Court ruling](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u7CAQBeCnwR2rAfxbUNzG3d42pcWa8YIyayyY2Ou3j5w8Qppp5ujT0fm4T3cXKa7P_-6Flt9LmlY8CiEz5ul0RIUzIj8TFoo75kSEeZ406FZCL8FM3kU6p7ry9gF-UBVa1fVN19SDVlWwavBDZ3pooTfd3GrTGmeGRzPXjUKFUEV7YdCDUQo0wK3VbjBeLQqNawa_iBrQR075xgEZ364sdKYd821Or4psYN6KMP-EHoUe-STMm9t-30KPly70CP111JW4CBlckQ-3ruhlwR2zI8lhlltO_mvmIgNmLPIIjiUn-bmmQ-ixytZvRySKpe1EDc-Xi_RTg_823m71dwAAAP__tb6DGw) in May that let state health officials classify synthetic hemp-derived THC as a Schedule I drug. Possession is now a state jail felony carrying up to two years and $10,000 in fines. Hemp retailers and a manufacturer [filed a federal lawsuit](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u2zAQhE9DdRSWS_1QBYs06l7alMJKXFoE1tIDxZj27QMbyAleNcUAH2a-P1_LFyVJx-033dmXZzyXg-slXArn5UUiV8nM5XbyJenB-RThvC0IOGhwGuwSKMlr6ZrgVwiTadib0fVj301omt1DdNAjIgRHkW0wQ79CHKiPKw6A3CT_hoEDawwgQDsgTTaYaNhSP4WoOuCQypnbsnPhJ11RXueDc7ud90b8Xsr3pewvhbPCudba1kj0LhXOlEvahBXO718KZzk3EoXzB_Q_ddk3vdKhD646cuBMooXq9TcVhTO6UU8ruWmMVmOcet3ZzmlyJmiMgTt0liwPTfbhuyaRdA2j6uB2pySfleVnbh8e_wUAAP__XnaMDg) on July 31 to block the ban, arguing it conflicts with the 2018 farm bill that legalized hemp nationwide. Cannabis experts estimate the change could pull [60% to 90% of products](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O5CAQxfHT4KxafLVtAoJNnM2mG1plKNpocGNBqad9-9XMFSZ-0k9P_38f6wfmkp-Pv3iQ53eq65O-eiFmauuFpXRuRPyo1Et-UaulUAurlnoEOYM0a8RcrtUO0W8yOjWQV9N8n-7WaTXsXs0mbHOK0ZjgEk3WorVxk5tzGEYXhuy_MTlLo5TUUt5Gjc5ElRQZvLuYhJUUM9d2452Y3thTueqL2i3UYyh-Zz67MH-EXoRecAvKfC9CL2ftLPTSj_pJ0Pd6djjwglRboAih1E6AR47wo8JOxwm8B9jwCYyf1IFSosBA75Mad-h4Cb0oNypjpknoZWg-nl-5lNzHSVj5ODCXn1_8u5ovr_8HAAD__-n7isw) from roughly 14,000 licensed stores statewide. The ban stems from a in May that let state health officials classify synthetic hemp-derived THC as a Schedule I drug. Possession is now a state jail felony carrying up to two years and $10,000 in fines. Hemp retailers and a manufacturer on July 31 to block the ban, arguing it conflicts with the 2018 farm bill that legalized hemp nationwide. Cannabis experts estimate the change could pull from roughly 14,000 licensed stores statewide. "It is going to do irreparable harm ," said Mark Bordas of the Texas Hemp Business Council. Supporters, citing rising cannabis poisoning calls involving children, welcomed the change. "It's about time ," said Aubree Adams of Citizens for a Safe and Healthy Texas. Investigators opened the case on July 17 after Buffalo Livestock Marketing reported that the cattle with nonsufficient funds checks totaling $159,604. Sheriff Kevin Ellis credited the Buffalo Police Department, the Texas & Southwestern Cattle Raisers Association, and the Navarro County Sheriff's Office for assisting in the investigation. Texas Stock Exchange Goes Fully Live The Texas Stock Exchange went , becoming the first new major stock exchange to launch in the U.S. in decades. Hello, I hope the summer is going great for you.
A surprising Politico [article](https://substack.com/redirect/6e391a6f-6dba-463b-ab7e-e2c2ad64b406?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) came out a couple days ago titled: "[Dems are increasingly desperate to get their Senate candidates to drop out of these races](https://substack.com/redirect/6e391a6f-6dba-463b-ab7e-e2c2ad64b406?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." It details how many or most Democrats want their Senate candidates in Montana and South Dakota to drop out and clear the way for Independents [Seth Bodnar](https://substack.com/redirect/9e2a1f34-b8a4-4932-9691-a42a61ff2fc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Brian Bengs](https://substack.com/redirect/21f98796-52e3-4ecb-98cf-5682d708abdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to have one-on-one matchups with the Republican candidates in these 2 reliably red states because the Democrats have no chance to compete while Seth and Brian do.
For example, in Montana, [Seth Bodnar](https://substack.com/redirect/9e2a1f34-b8a4-4932-9691-a42a61ff2fc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is statistically tied with the Republican Kurt Alme if it's one-on-one, while the Democrat Alani Bankhead polls way behind in every circumstance. The Democrat Bankhead raised only $35,000 this quarter, with only $21,000 on hand (!!!). Meanwhile, Seth Bodnar raised over $1.1 million with almost $1 million on hand. Kurt Alme, the Republican raised $800,000 and has $1.4 million on hand.
Read that again: the Independent [Seth Bodnar](https://substack.com/redirect/9e2a1f34-b8a4-4932-9691-a42a61ff2fc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) raised 30 times more this quarter and has almost 50 times more money than the Democrat and is essentially at parity with the Republican. This is categorically a race where the Democrat is the spoiler.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a6d6a12f-53a0-4b9c-b20a-2b95f94169b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Dem nominee in Montana, Alani Bankhead, says "nobody ever knows what's actually going to happen in an election," and "absolutely nothing" short of an act of God will get her to drop out of the race. Meanwhile, Nancy Keenan, the former executive director of the Montana Democratic Party who has endorsed Bodnar along with former Senator Jon Tester wrote that "there is not a viable path for a Democratic victory in this race."
It's infuriating that a candidate with no real shot is going to give this race to the Republican. Talk about a spoiler.
The gulf in South Dakota between Independent [Brian Bengs](https://substack.com/redirect/21f98796-52e3-4ecb-98cf-5682d708abdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Democrat Julian Beaudion is not quite as enormous - $113,000 to $18,000 this quarter - but the dynamic is the same. [Bengs](https://substack.com/redirect/21f98796-52e3-4ecb-98cf-5682d708abdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Independent, polls competitively with South Dakota Republican Senator Mike Rounds while Beaudion is a non-factor statewide.
As a former candidate myself, I've always been reluctant to call on anyone to drop out of a race. Deciding to run for office is a huge personal commitment, and the sacrifice deserves some measure of deference and respect. That said, for these 2 candidates, the choice to continue is clearly playing into the hands of the opposition.
Will they do the right thing?
I confess to being totally rapt as to whether Alani Bankhead and Julian Beaudion will adopt some common sense and drop out. I've been surprised by the level of press and near un-animity that Bankhead and Beaudion should step aside. If they continue to run as no-hope candidates, they will ensure that there's no genuine competition in these 2 U.S. Senate races. Alternatively, if they step aside and clear the way for Independent candidates with genuine followings to provide real challenges to their opponents, they could change national politics for the better.
For Beaudion in South Dakota, decision day is tomorrow. The deadline for Bankhead in Montana to see the light is August 10th. We will find out very quickly if South Dakota and Montana join Nebraska and [Idaho](https://substack.com/redirect/7ea84c1e-ed26-4dc5-8910-1886ae95d4d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as states where Independent candidates are creating contests where no one expected. I hope they do, for the good of the country.

| | Dear Fellow American,

**I’m excited to let you know about our free documentary course, “Marxism, Socialism, and Communism,” which will educate you on the dangers and problems inherent in these destructive ideologies. Every American—but especially our young people—should understand these ideologies.**

Today, Marxism goes by different names to make itself seem less dangerous. I'm sure you've heard of "critical race theory," "gender theory," or even "decolonization."

I know these disguises do not fool you.

“Marxism, Socialism, and Communism” is one of our most important courses **because the source of these dangerous ideologies is still Karl Marx.**

It’s the same Marxism that works to destroy your property and your country.

It’s the same Marxism that seeks to abolish your family and your God.

And it’s the same Marxism that leads to famines, show trials, gulags, and other atrocities.

The truth is, there's nothing fundamentally _new_ about this "new" Marxism, except for one crucial fact...

**... it's more popular with our youth than ever before. **

By way of example, the mayor of our largest city vowed to replace “rugged individualism” with the “warmth of collectivism.” Clearly, this issue isn’t going away.

That’s why I invite you to gain a deeper understanding of the history of Marxism as well as the threat it poses to our liberty.

[**You can do that by registering for “Marxism, Socialism, and Communism” today.**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcuK3DAQRb9G3tnoZVu98CLB09lkJuQBsxSaUrW7QC8seZL8fRhw_0C2deAUh_v6bJ8dBUrbi4u4UK3WZ2-j2_9QjVvG-vbX0-2GO6aWXLSSy6nnpufKOmj0jla7zi-jFOZmOlzEbMZ5NNMkuvsCXM2zHsUb6EmAvniJggsUo-beGwMdLR8-brgSkmthBkBzcQizGUFfJgSm-VG8azhQquSxQs6l5ECNoA5537qw3FsrlalPTF6ZvFK65eFOIVTvAg7oDyavZ09faUv9UZi6VmBq5WIazQuXWn6VYv22Pj39ZHI6WrQ1HzsgU2vZcy0IjdJ2ooiejsjUitFROI_gYnG0JabW89cD5NQwNabWz1_s97l__fWjfzR3--LLbwqB6jQzzbcP4QA5du1_l3hf5L8AAAD__7kwmQg)

This free online course is more urgent than ever. We are at a critical time for our country, and Marxism--under a variety of names--continues to infiltrate our culture.

body:
When we passed this map, there was no guarantee Democrats would flip these five seats.

I am writing to ask you directly and respectfully -- please split a contribution between five must-win Democratic campaigns for Congress in California.
These are the seats we can flip because of our Election Rigging Response Act. None of them are sure things, but every one of them is needed to take back the House.

**Hi everyone,**
**Election Day is almost here, and we're making one final push to reach voters before the polls close!**
**Join us virtually for our FINAL Election Day phonebank for Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs. This is an all-day, drop-in event—our Google Meet will be open from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, so you can hop on whenever you have time. **Let's make every call count!****See you on Election Day,
Elizabeth**

Peter,
Mike Johnson lied to my face and ripped food out of the mouths of the hungriest children in the country.
In the summer of 2023, I went to Washington, DC, as part of a delegation of farmers from Louisiana who were invited to lobby for the Farm Bill.
We went to dozens of offices -- including Mike Johnson's. I was the only one to go. I thought to myself: This is my representative. I deserve to have a conversation with him about my livelihood, our country's farming programs, and what they do for the communities that rely on them.

| I showed up at his office. We had a one-on-one, closed-door conversation. I looked him in the eyes, and I asked him to do something to make it easier for a farmer like me to connect to SNAP and EBT recipients--to get more healthy food at low cost into the hands of people in my community who need it most.
He told me that providing fresh, healthy food to SNAP recipients was a "bipartisan issue." He told me I could count on him to get it done.
I walked away feeling hopeful that my representative might finally do something to help the people in his District. I couldn't have been more wrong. He had lied to my face.
At the first chance he got, Mike Johnson gutted SNAP for Louisianans and millions of people across the country. The Big Ugly Bill cut SNAP by 30% and a billion dollars from the Farm to Food Bank and school programs. A program I was proud to participate in.
I knew then: Actions speak a hell of a lot louder than words. Across the country, 700,000 children lost SNAP benefits. Thousands died. Families barely surviving could no longer survive. Mike Johnson lied to my face and then ripped food out of the mouths of hungry children who I could've fed with the food I'm proud to grow on my farm.
I'm Conrad Cable and I decided to run to fire Mike Johnson after MAGA Republicans cut a billion dollars from the programs that keep my community alive. I couldn't stand by and watch him any longer. clean_body: Peter, The ink was barely dry on last night's primary results when the attacks started. Cook Political Report downgraded our Senate race from "Likely Republican" to "Lean Republican." That is not a clerical change. The Democrats and their allies in the media have been waiting for this moment. Now they have it. And within hours of our runoff victory, they are already targeting us. Here is what Cook Political Report's Jessica Taylor wrote this morning: Talarico has a "fundraising edge" that Paxton must overcome. The Democrats and their allies in the media are doing everything in their power to expand that edge in order to flip a Senate seat. They will pour in outside money. They will flood the airwaves. They will do everything in their power to make Texas a national test case for their failed agenda. I won with the support of President Trump and the grassroots conservatives of Texas. We won the primary. Now we must win Texas. I will not sugarcoat it: the path ahead is harder than it should be because the establishment sat on the sidelines. | | | | | | Peter,

**The movement for liberty is growing stronger across New Hampshire.**

Every election brings a choice between bigger government and the freedoms that have made our state exceptional.

That is why Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire is proud to announce our second round of primary election endorsements!

**These 21 candidates have signed** [The Pledge](https://us.list-manage.com/QyxdsTw4DMa?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70), making a public commitment to defend the values that matter most.

They are making a promise to you to protect individual liberty, limited government, parental rights, self-defense, election integrity, and the constitutional principles that have made New Hampshire the home of the Live Free or Die spirit.

Patriot, it's Dinesh D'Souza.

I want to share something deeply personal with you today. Something I've never said quite this way before.

**The night before I was set to be locked away, I made a decision that changed everything about how I fight and how I've fought ever since.**

I'm not going to bury the lead: _**what I learned in that moment is the same thing I believe every patriot in this movement needs to hear right now. **_

Because what we're facing today is a threat to everything we've built — it can feel like the walls are closing in.

I know that feeling.

**And what I learned on the other side of it is something I've passed on to only a handful of people I trust most, including my son-in-law Brandon Gill who took it to Dartmouth, then took it to Washington, and uses it every single day to expose and dismantle the radical left in ways they never saw coming!**

[_**I'm sharing it with you now because I think you need it.**_](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=2fe03e5e11fa45519234c887d96c8760&_e=T0e94AK6dZg3VpgZiAMJZUd0hcaCgIU7BeE6XPrHPHLThFT717dtNmOeLKGWrVGHWVreh4GoMRt7hy6pp7aud9r4t42LsiqWaYr7zSN7XxCvYY2QscHivZEMpppjyH3Mvhx36JToTUo2gZZt_kb5KHaUeS-8WfHKDDXEwnKsIbn589P1OdxqRLk1iy46qjQ3m37qcLn6eOGb9NAGwyPR5KR-X5cOcwHtXgpRlmNFbi-YF88SBuBq7jLHEs9vszCce75gDJRO3P4VNhHs8rtJMsXReVbypAlzjHEWP5NbFrnNEzDVxvtXEXdtic0lyIHQ-ufgRebadEbRE_QNod9QkRKybOJG9ph1aX1vnS2kXI6rK-QQ-vHRsKwoJNEYnnZi01fA55dxDXYIW1Mey9c4xjgQ2ufFK-lr56krMNiym9jOl_seek_Y-Q2dVLgsXkvtf0eV5w3TqUCA3-R_94uRr_T14M15Vcug7E8iQjJQK5s006k-gtFoYzD1IN-27x8T52OaSOINvFJObhJNs1xUMve_KvoO9eihiNk1O94fE6B1z7hL4Yd-vIac-0TB_tlD)

Don’t look at this as another fundraising pitch or one of those doomsday warnings.

I hope this will instead give you a genuine glimmer of hope about what we're up against — and exactly how we're going to win.

[_**I've written it all out in a full personal note. I hope you'll take a few minutes to read it.**_](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=2fe03e5e11fa45519234c887d96c8760&_e=T0e94AK6dZg3VpgZiAMJZUd0hcaCgIU7BeE6XPrHPHLThFT717dtNmOeLKGWrVGHWVreh4GoMRt7hy6pp7aud9r4t42LsiqWaYr7zSN7XxCvYY2QscHivZEMpppjyH3Mvhx36JToTUo2gZZt_kb5KHaUeS-8WfHKDDXEwnKsIbmPy6Y3XLPmT7MjN2oyXHOAs7RBKjl3bpSZlNCEGdViuMZkug45KCQUCPD7cI54SpZ1MdcfsIK-eRN68MKCRwrQ282Jqx9e50eUFEZIIvfC2DNh8iDtYAl3gtNOQpEak7WtctiiPbtYlmn8UVnaDoPMYlIeACyHR6S2yfpBKxejZwMLc-D7BDxvacB2ovnEmN-5rPFFDP4-rSi1rv7Jy0aMBj8Aetw-WdGlzEL_YzXO54NXoxQlidzA2960K1pwNYEKrDliwoZGRCEH3mCBhUxugypTykE0al60LSxDil5LLVT0S4XdLoWYDFm3rpvtWnWXBoXXLpDyKpk_9113cYM2x8d398U_Jrk7r_HNY0-c_D-dEYXhL1WWkMoqgimeSx-Z5lygdvM2gT8DkXs_VeXV)

subject: No pardon for Ghislaine Maxwell. Full stop!
body:

Yesterday, the United States Senate did something extraordinary: every single senator — Democrat and Republican — agreed that Ghislaine Maxwell should never receive a pardon for helping Jeffrey Epstein abuse children.
Unanimous. Not one senator objected.
Know what I have to say about it? GOOD!
This is the bill I have been championing in the House for months. This EXACT SAME RESOLUTION.
Before we go any further, will you CLICK HERE to chip in $5, $10, or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now right now to help me finish what I started? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Here's why this moment means so much to me:
Months ago, I introduced the House version of this exact resolution. I stood with Epstein survivors and said plainly: Maxwell has shown no guilt, no remorse, not one ounce of accountability for what she did to those children. I demanded the Department of Justice release the full Epstein files. I sent letter after letter to Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche warning him against any deal.
And I said it then, and I'll say it now: Justice must never be for sale. Especially not to someone who preyed on children.
Let's be completely honest about what is happening here:
Ghislaine Maxwell facilitated the sexual abuse and trafficking of minors. She was convicted. She was sentenced to 20 years. And yet Donald Trump has refused, again and again, to rule out giving her a pardon — because Maxwell's own lawyer has made clear she is dangling testimony that could "clear Trump's name" in exchange for her freedom.
Now that the Senate has spoken with one voice, there is no excuse left. The House must immediately pass my resolution and send it to the President's desk — and force Donald Trump to either sign it or show the entire country exactly whose side he's really on.
I am not going to let this go quietly into a news cycle and disappear. The survivors of Epstein's crimes have waited long enough for justice. They deserve leaders who will not stop demanding it — no matter who gets uncomfortable.
No pardon. No deal. A convicted child predator does not get to buy her freedom with lies about the President. Chip in $25 or $50 right now and help me hold the line. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
No pardon. No commutation. No deal.
Justice is not for sale.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | The image you’re seeing in the news today isn’t what you think it is. | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend, A little girl sat alone in the dark. Lured online by someone pretending to care and taken from her home. Kidnapped and hidden away in a remote cabin, where she was abused, and sold online. And passed from one man to another. **Her name is Alice.**
---
[ Rescue A Child Now ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
And this is the part most people never hear. **She was found. An investigator in Florida traced her trafficker’s username. He saw a connection others missed and contacted the FBI.** Agents followed the digital trail, tracing the trafficker’s **IP address**. They moved in, raided the location and rescued her. **Alive.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Her trafficker now faces **20 years to life** in prison. This is what happens when someone goes looking.
This is what happens when the right tools are in place. But there are still so many children who have not been found yet. Still waiting.
Still trapped.
---
[ Rescue A Child Now ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
And that is why the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists. Friend, if this is your first time hearing about us, the **Sound of Freedom Foundation’s** mission is clear: **_To stop the sale of God’s children._** The foundation extends the reach of the _Sound of Freedom_ film, bringing awareness to the reality of child trafficking and taking action to stop it. Our vision is simple: **_A world where every child is safe and free._** We work with partners to prevent exploitation before it begins, support rescue operations, and equip investigators. Our partners walk with survivors as they heal and rebuild their lives. Because rescue is only the beginning. And right now, there is an urgent need. We are launching ** _Operation Search and Rescue,_** a __ mission to connect investigators and agents, identify traffickers, and build criminal evidence.

We will support real rescue operations using tools like **digital tracking and face recognition**. This is how children are found and how traffickers are stopped.
And today, you can be part of it. **And right now, your donation will be matched, dollar for dollar.** **A concerned Child Defense Organization** **has approved** **a** **$10,000 MATCHING GRANT**.

clean_body: She was rescued. Many are still waiting. You can help find them. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend, A little girl sat alone in the dark. Lured online by someone pretending to care and taken from her home. Kidnapped and hidden away in a remote cabin, where she was abused, and sold online. And passed from one man to another. Her name is Alice. And this is the part most people never hear. She was found. An investigator in Florida traced her trafficker’s username. He saw a connection others missed and contacted the FBI. Agents followed the digital trail, tracing the trafficker’s IP address. They moved in, raided the location and rescued her. Alive. Her trafficker now faces 20 years to life in prison. This is what happens when someone goes looking. This is what happens when the right tools are in place. But there are still so many children who have not been found yet. Still waiting. Still trapped. And that is why the Sound of Freedom Foundation exists. Friend, if this is your first time hearing about us, the Sound of Freedom Foundation’s mission is clear: To stop the sale of God’s children. The foundation extends the reach of the Sound of Freedom film, bringing awareness to the reality of child trafficking and taking action to stop it. Our vision is simple: A world where every child is safe and free. We work with partners to prevent exploitation before it begins, support rescue operations, and equip investigators. Our partners walk with survivors as they heal and rebuild their lives. Because rescue is only the beginning. And right now, there is an urgent need. We are launching Operation Search and Rescue, a mission to connect investigators and agents, identify traffickers, and build criminal evidence. We will support real rescue operations using tools like digital tracking and face recognition. This is how children are found and how traffickers are stopped. And today, you can be part of it. And right now, your donation will be matched, dollar for dollar. A concerned Child Defense Organization has approved a $10,000 MATCHING GRANT. Every dollar you give will be doubled. $25 Gift Doubles to $50 $50 Gift Doubles to $100 $100 Gift Doubles to $200 $250 Gift Doubles to $500 $500 Gift Doubles to $1,000 Your gift goes twice as far to help find and rescue children. This is God multiplying love. Jesus said, “Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me.”(Matthew 18:5) Today you can be that welcome. You can enable the search and help the rescue mission to bring a child home. Please give as generously as you can while your gift is matched. And please pray for Alice, and for the children still waiting. And for the day when every child is safe and free. Because God’s children are not for sale._ With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verástegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

For the first time ever, **Americans will soon be able to hold precious metals** (like gold & silver) inside 401(k)s.

That means **more than $12 trillion in retirement savings** could soon start flowing into the precious-metals market, creating one of the largest wealth shifts in modern history.

Since the announcement, gold prices have **soared from $3,400 to over $4,000 per ounce** , a 17% jump in just months.

Once the order takes effect in 2026, **J.P. Morgan** believes the demand could send gold prices toward **$6,000 per ounce.**

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. | Monday, August 3, 2026| Trump Halts Iran Strike
---|---
6-minute read · 4 stories
Lead Story · The WarTRUMP CALLS OFF 'WWII-LEVEL' STRIKE ON IRAN, SAYS HORMUZ DEAL IS CLOSEWhat's Happening
* Over the weekend, President Trump said he canceled a planned strike on Iran that he called the **“biggest attack since World War II,”** claiming “the perimeters of a deal” had been agreed to.
* Trump said the deal would include the “immediate, complete, and total” reopening of the **Strait of Hormuz** and an end to Iran's nuclear program.
* He told reporters aboard Air Force One that Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, and Iran itself had asked him to hold off, and said negotiations would begin Monday afternoon.

The Situation
* Iran's Foreign Ministry pushed back, saying “We are not currently holding any talks with the American side” and signaling it had no plans to send negotiators abroad.
* The Associated Press counts this as at least the **eighth time** Trump has paused military action citing an imminent deal — twice in April, once in May, twice in June, twice in July, and now August.
* Trump acknowledged the repeated false starts, saying at Friday's Cabinet meeting, “I'm losing faith in them, because they do lie.”

The PerspectiveThe president is right to prefer a verifiable deal that reopens Hormuz and ends Tehran's nuclear ambitions over a strike whose consequences no one can fully predict — and keeping the military option credible is what brought Iran to the table at all. But eight walkbacks in five months is a pattern, not a strategy. Tehran has learned it can buy time by dangling talks, and even allies like Saudi Arabia would rather wait. If Iran again proves it was never serious, restoring deterrence will take more than another deadline.[Read the full story at Washington Examiner](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_F0KAElx4yVoiF03sTMUTyUBb-B5qTNG5bTLFG28txgxYF1zpsnLGggLaJUpm_40GYTk5VEGQSS73nwoaR2gJzDQ-x9fWf2H66FPjX37ygCkAhTG3VyWPrmYYmanw8keZd4JfouQQ8vWj8JZKmwUnDVVk7Db4ldWF5v9KOn2OaUq6JUaIYWCNLKG5NoX0PbfZDxe7rE_zSIyXkFkarjJ_zp_jNQi-dI-GpQ7-SzPFjKPSWKn5j1n-XCXb_oh0rKxX89ArqfeNsKcRoJE2UhOmn1PkMP188nja-dhuUDqGyoP2f7VMeJd4CtAynWxUZuMg42inmmPa4FL8ziO_n3v5vCpeCycMxTIUJKiBwRSzF-kMDYwMxV2VyKD1ei4iqYZPQ/4sv/rKvwxUzCS0aUCEPms2S3Eg/h5/h001.jCM_Mzaso-NpAsFB4yx7d8Nii08KV2hPgnq3vYoFNX4)

The Justice DepartmentBLANCHE BACK ON TRACK FOR ATTORNEY GENERAL AFTER DEAL WITH GOP HOLDOUTSWhat's Happening
* Sen. John Cornyn (R-TX) announced a Sunday-night deal with the Justice Department that clears acting AG **Todd Blanche's** path to confirmation before the August recess.
* The DOJ agreed to issue a formal order permanently terminating Trump's “anti-weaponization” fund and to confirm in a binding written document that a May IRS audit settlement applies only to the plaintiffs, including the president.
* The Senate Judiciary Committee, which postponed a vote earlier in the week, has rescheduled it for **Tuesday.**

The Situation
* Cornyn and Sen. Thom Tillis (R-NC) had refused to advance Blanche without written assurances the administration would honor his hearing testimony.
* Republicans feared the fund could be used to pay Jan. 6 defendants; Trump said Sunday he “might revive” it if Blanche isn't confirmed: “If they don't approve Todd, I'll put it back on the table.”
* Majority Leader John Thune (R-SD) has signaled interest in a floor vote if the nomination advances Tuesday; both Cornyn and Tillis are retiring at year's end.

The PerspectiveThis is how the Senate's advice-and-consent role is supposed to work. Cornyn and Tillis used their leverage to get commitments in writing rather than taking assurances on faith — a reasonable ask given how easily a fund built to fight “weaponization” could become its own weapon. Blanche should be confirmed on the merits, and the written guardrails make it easier for institutionalists to vote yes without worrying about how settlement money gets spent down the road.[Read the full story at Washington Examiner](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_F0KAElx4yVoiF03sTMUTyWFa1tWox1t_YE5rpY7L5b5UClA631pUYmqElCdMnhAxLNMjxR78a9-qHs9OULAgW5n3Ydvjx4sjzZ_dKlXFi-MpxID08i7593wnF5MkW6JIta7-Hl8AOu17g_eNVP64lleHXCWSjRYiKT72qWIvUermRIPVweG-e63ItyVs67ao4x8oxurmmm_R94QnFp22TiribTSNzW0iA0mTynf9n3aU0KblJMZFFc-NzVbl3kMKhdPWCcpfNesvrCqwHitr69bb_i2bZg73pQxep21UP9ESuHo8Bh4Mr8LyvR9c_8CT_UKNM4EYlCm2Ie3Lqwr7b5dNPc674YBaSk3gJV0JS6q/4sv/rKvwxUzCS0aUCEPms2S3Eg/h6/h001.floK74eQDrTu43na6d4x2cuWRQEp1R70u17L_y64Iis)

Election IntegritySAVE ACT STALLS IN SENATE — AND LIKELY TOO LATE FOR 2026What's Happening
* The Senate left Washington last Thursday without moving the **SAVE America Act** , which would require documentary proof of citizenship to register and photo ID to vote nationwide.
* Majority Leader John Thune (R-SD) says there aren't 60 votes to beat a filibuster and won't put it on the floor in the four days before the six-week recess.
* Trump has pressed Thune to scrap the filibuster or force a recorded vote; Sen. Mike Lee and others want the August recess canceled to pass it.

The Situation
* Election-law experts say that even if it passed now, the **“Purcell principle”** — courts' reluctance to change election rules close to an election — would likely block it before November.
* Steve Bannon noted federal law limits changes to voter rolls in the window before an election, arguing the cycle is past “the point of no return.”
* Supporters like Sen. Lee and Tea Party Patriots' Jenny Beth Martin say it should pass anyway; Lee quoted VP Vance that “this is bigger than the 2026 elections.”

The PerspectiveProof of citizenship to register and ID to vote are common-sense safeguards that large majorities support, and passing the SAVE Act would be a win regardless of when it takes effect. But conservatives should be honest about the calendar: with fewer than 100 days to the midterms, courts are almost certain to hold any new rules until 2028, so telling the base this secures November invites disappointment. It's worth remembering, too, that a vulnerability in the rolls is not the same as proven fraud. name: Dylan for Wisconsin
subject: Can You Help Us Get Out the Early Vote?
body:
It’s time to get out the vote! Join Team Dylan to talk to your friends & neighbors about Dylan Helmenstine and his campaign for State Treasurer!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ed51042cdaa4/c2y1sg9w12-10123233?e=f59034ca3e)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/OAF5Jgl9wZ9?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,
With the August 11th Primary Election fast approaching, every day is an opportunity to make an impact in the State Treasurer race. We saw in [last week’s State Navigate poll ](https://us.list-manage.com/kTNHpjDaR9X?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)that a remarkable number of voters have yet to follow this race closely, and we need your help making sure they’ve heard Dylan’s name!
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/87fvAzHX2tg?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |
This year, our elections are critical. We need to ensure the strongest possible down-ballot candidates can win in August and help deliver a blue trifecta in November.
During this early vote period, we are focused on increasing Dylan's vote turnout by boosting name recognition with voters who are early voting without a plan for casting their vote for treasurer. We will be holding Dylan signs, speaking with voters, and offering to share Dylan lit near key polling places, while remaining 100+ feet away from polling place entrances.
If you are able to help, please join us to make a difference with Dylan’s campaign! [**Use this form to let us know when and where you would like to volunteer, and a member of our campaign will follow up to confirm.**](https://us.list-manage.com/ZKmVnGOdjWr?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
You can also join Dylan (and bring your friends!) to two upcoming events in Dane County!
* On [_**August 6th, join Dylan and Rep. Alex Joers for an afternoon picnic**_](https://us.list-manage.com/OjW2C0VsdhP?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09) _**!**_
* On [_**August 9th, join Dylan and Congressman Mark Pocan for a very special fundraiser!**_](https://us.list-manage.com/128WSVav7rG?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)

---
| [Sign Up To Help Get Out The Early Vote!](https://us.list-manage.com/6FnW6XKEiqU?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
---
| |
Thank you for supporting Dylan for Wisconsin!
Sincerely,Team Dylan
---

name: GIFFORDS.org
subject: One last push
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends --
We have an exciting update.
Just a few weeks ago, Donald Trump’s administration announced that they would be working to roll back a lot of our hard-fought progress on gun safety. You’ve helped us speak out.
Thousands of you have taken action and let the Trump administration know that the safety of your community, your schools, and your family comes before lining the gun lobby’s pockets.
**If you haven’t had the chance to weigh in and push back yet, you still have time! We’re hoping for one last push on three very dangerous proposals before August 6. We’ve also added scripts below that you can easily copy-paste to the ATF:**
* * *

1. **Revising Non-Over-the-Counter Firearms Transaction Requirements** : This rule would make it easier for people who should not have guns to get guns—delivered right to their door. Anyone could purchase a deadly firearm without any in-person interaction with a gun dealer.

My name is [NAME], and I am writing to OPPOSE the “Revising Non-Over-the-Counter Firearms Transaction Requirements” rule proposed by the ATF.
This rule is a dangerous step towards allowing access to guns to those who should not have them, including criminals, traffickers and underage children. It is unnecessary and will weaken background checks systems while putting our communities in danger.
[Insert 1-2 sentences here about your opposition to the rule].

**[SUBMIT PUBLIC COMMENTS](https://go.giffords.org/go/68408?t=1&akid=11686%2E3935704%2EhiZudS)**

* * *

2. **Defining “Willfully” for Firearms Violations:** Gun shops are not federally required to train their employees. This is not an exaggeration. And the Trump administration has proposed that a license can only be revoked if a dealer acted willfully and knows that their employees violated the law. But if the employees are never trained on the law, how will they know if they broke it? This loophole gives shady dealers legal cover to look the other way.

I write to express my strong opposition to the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives’ “Defining Willfully for Firearm Violations” notice of proposed rulemaking (RIN 1140-AA88).
It is important that gun shop owners and their employees know about and adhere to the laws on how to safely sell firearms to only those who should have them, with the larger goal of keeping us all safe. No small business owner should have to jump through hoops to keep their business open; however, there is a reasonable responsibility when people are selling guns that they know the laws and know how to adhere to them.
This rule would allow shady dealers to break the law and claim it wasn’t willful, despite there being no effort to ensure the law is known and followed.
The ATF should be working to keep Americans safe, not turning the other cheek when bad dealers break the law and allow firearms to be accessed by those who would do us harm.
[Insert 1-2 sentences here about your opposition to the rule].

**[SUBMIT PUBLIC COMMENTS](https://go.giffords.org/go/68454?t=2&akid=11686%2E3935704%2EhiZudS)**

* * *

3. **Interstate Transport and Temporary Export of National Firearms Act** : Most Americans want law enforcement to have the tools and information they need to do their jobs safely. Currently, when someone from one state decides to drive into another state with a machine gun, short-barreled rifle or shotgun, silencer, or even a grenade, they are required to ask the ATF for approval to transport the weapons. The goal is to ensure that state and federal law enforcement know where these dangerous weapons are and ensure that no state laws are broken. Now, this administration wants to remove the requirement to seek approval and, for those traveling less than a year, owners of these especially deadly weapons would not even need to provide notice. This is dangerous and shortsighted.

I write to express my strong opposition to the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives’ “Instate Transport and Temporary Export of National Firearms Act” notice of proposed rulemaking (RIN 1140-AA89).
At a time of ongoing mass shootings and increased political violence, the ATF should not be trying to skirt state laws and allow people to travel across state lines with especially deadly firearms with no notice to federal and state law enforcement. These changes would put not only communities at risk, but also endanger law enforcement—routine traffic stops could easily turn deadly. There are multiple examples of people traveling across multiple states with the goal of doing harm, and the ATF should be trying to stop this from happening, not making it easier.
[INSERT PERSONAL REASON FOR OPPOSITION]
For the safety of communities and our law enforcement, I urge you to not move forward with this dangerous rule.

**[SUBMIT PUBLIC COMMENTS](https://go.giffords.org/go/68481?t=3&akid=11686%2E3935704%2EhiZudS)**

* * *

Your work to push back on the administration’s dangerous proposed rules sends a powerful message that Americans still support commonsense gun safety measures and oppose moves that would lead to more violence and death while also placing our law enforcement in harm’s way.
Thank you.
GIFFORDS

**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260803-1-b&t=4&akid=11686%2E3935704%2EhiZudS)**

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=5&akid=11686%2E3935704%2EhiZudS) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
Tomorrow is
our primary election, and Michiganders will finally have a chance to make
their voices heard.

Everyone on Team Benson is spending the next two days running at full
speed, making sure we leave nothing on the table. As we prepare for the
next stage of this election, I’m reflecting on why I’m running to be the
next governor of Michigan. I’ll get into my story in a moment, but first I
have to ask: [ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/10900?t=1001&akid=1765%2E181023%2EjTXU-V ]Can you chip in $5 or $10 today to help power our campaign
in the last few hours before Election Day?

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/10901?t=1002&akid=1765%2E181023%2EjTXU-V ]Donate →

Ever since I was a student, I knew I wanted to fight for justice and make
a difference. I’m the daughter of two special education teachers. I was
raised in a working class family that instilled in me the values of hard
work, opportunity, and serving others.

It’s why I started my career investigating threats to democracy and civil
rights in the US and abroad.

It’s why I became a law clerk in Detroit, fighting to protect and defend
people’s civil rights and freedoms.

It’s why, as Dean of Wayne State University Law School, I worked to ensure
all students could afford their education by freezing tuition and
expanding scholarships.

And it’s why as Secretary of State, I’ve fought to make everyday life
easier for all Michiganders, secure our elections, and expand voter
access.

But I know our work is far from finished. That’s why I’m running for
governor to make sure Michigan is a place where everyone — from our kids
to our seniors — can stay and thrive.

As your governor, I will use every tool available to make life easier,
from expanding rural healthcare to building more housing to ensuring
anyone can afford to live in the best place to call home. But I can’t do
it without your help.

Tomorrow this campaign enters a new — and more competitive — stage. MAGA
billionaires and special interests will start to flood their nominee with
support and focus their attacks on our movement. But I know we’re building
a grassroots-powered campaign ready to take on the National GOP and win
one of the most important governor’s races in the country.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/10901?t=1003&akid=1765%2E181023%2EjTXU-V ]That’s why I’m personally asking: will you please pitch in whatever you
can spare before tomorrow’s primary to help power my campaign?

# **Good guy with a gun stops Idaho fast food shooting**
Jordan Salinas, 35, a healthcare worker who had been horseback riding with his girlfriend, pulled into a Twin Falls, Idaho In-N-Out Burger Saturday when a mass shooting erupted. Using military-style techniques, Salinas **[drew his legally owned suppressed pistol and engaged gunman](https://substack.com/redirect/abe2bf6c-ec80-444d-aadd-895a79bd7de9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Chad Williams after watching him raise a rifle and fire toward vehicles in the drive-thru -- the first time Salinas had ever aimed his weapon at another person.

* **Williams retreated from the drive-thru after encountering return fire from both Salinas and an off-duty police officer dining at the restaurant.** He later died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound in a nearby parking lot. * **Salinas said witnessing a 2021 Boise mall shooting had motivated him to train** for exactly such a scenario, reasoning that his role as caregiver for his wheelchair-bound brother made preparation essential.

# **Trump calls off Iran attack, announces new talks beginning Monday**
President Trump canceled a planned "massive" strike on Iran over the weekend after private appeals from Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, and Iran itself. Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke directly with Trump Saturday, relaying that regional allies preferred a negotiated settlement and believed a deal was imminent. Trump said he deferred to the Gulf states' judgment, asking the crown prince whether he'd rather have an attack or a deal.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8b019480-d656-480f-a3f0-2c077c7a2c04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

The US position remains that Iran must agree to a cease-fire before substantive talks can proceed. Trump acknowledged skepticism about Iran's reliability, noting Iranian officials have previously contradicted what they told him privately.
* **Trump stressed the US military remains ready to strike at any moment** and declined to set a deadline for reaching a permanent agreement.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/3HNCIL7A7ho?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)

Cue the [classic 1986 song ](https://us.list-manage.com/oGpzdqQZZXq?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)from that Swedish hair metal band: It’s the final countdown to the Democratic primary for US Congress in the Fifth District.
I am pushing to make my final case, and some of the local media is finally beginning to provide some coverage. The ill-fated redistricting referendum sucked all the energy out of Virginia politics for a while, and I’ve been hearing that turnout for early voting in the primary is low. I expect there will be a lot of people who are just tuning in to this contest in the next couple of days—and I’m ready for them.
I’ll point you to two particularly good bits of press coverage—and ask you to send them on to as many people as possible.
_Cville Right Now_ posted an [excellent profile](https://us.list-manage.com/tC9HuWI8MYG?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) that includes something I think will resonate with a lot of people
“Tracinski also hopes voters will appreciate that he’s a Washington outsider, not a career politician.
“‘I’m not somebody who wanted to be in politics or wants to be in politics,’ Tracinski said. ‘I’m doing this purely because I didn’t want to see our democracy go without a fight. And so I’m here to accomplish some key things to put the American system back together and make it function again. And then I’m going to be very happy to return home to a peaceful life.’”
I’m like that guy in the movie everyone’s talking about right now. I just want the chaos to be over so I can go back home. And I think a lot of other people would also like to be able to [put an oar on our shoulders](https://us.list-manage.com/17r5Ywsz54A?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) and lead a quiet life again.
See [another profile](https://us.list-manage.com/zNtdBQeqSSK?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) in _Cardinal News_.
“His main campaign platform is to restore the Constitutional balance in Washington, DC, and rein in the power of ‘an out of control president.’
“‘I think there’s a big realignment going on in the national and even international political debate that the big alternative of our era is liberal democracy versus authoritarianism, and so we need to be standing up for liberal democracy and defending it,’ he said.
“He added that campaigning has given him hope, in an era of divisive politics, that the people he has met on campaign stops have been welcoming and interested in civil dialogue, regardless of their political affiliation.
“‘It’s been a lot more Norman Rockwell-esque than I had hoped for,’ he said. ‘What you see online is not necessarily representative of the American people.’
“His one-line summary of his campaign, he said, is that ‘The US Congress is a good idea and it would be nice if we had one.’”
_Cardinal News_ also sent out a long and interesting questionnaire, to which I gave some thoughtful and well-crafted answers—and apparently I was the only candidate to answer at all, so you can see my responses [here](https://us.list-manage.com/tDYF51wgUhH?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) (scroll all the way down).
If you like what I’m saying, support my campaign. This is your **last chance** to help out before the primary this Tuesday, August 4, so please donate **now**.

### Why Not Just Vote for Tom?

Part of my goal for the last few days of the primary is to differentiate myself from my opponents and especially from the more established choice, Tom Perriello.
I recently posted a video taking that head-on: “[Why Not Just Vote for Tom?](https://us.list-manage.com/9QWnZ4VdoFc?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)”
The main “why not” is from [another profile of the candidates](https://us.list-manage.com/nAbpggVfSi5?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) posted by a local TV station, which includes this response from Perriello on data centers.
“Where communities oppose data centers, I’m gonna fight like heck next to them to make sure those data centers don’t come in. And where a community wants a data center, I will fight equally as hard to make sure they get the best terms available.”
As I replied:
“Spoken like a true politician. Like data centers? He’s with you! Don’t like data centers? He’s also with you! All things to all people.
“I’m on record that after the primary, if Tom wins, I will support him over the Republican incumbent, John McGuire, who does not represent the people of the Fifth District and only answers to Donald Trump....
“My agenda is first and foremost about defending democracy and restoring the power of Congress. We need someone who believes in that cause, not just someone who will do it if the polls happen to look good at the moment.”
Similarly, I posted a [somewhat long response](https://us.list-manage.com/4vLCQotcYpN?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) to the idea that AI is going to take all our jobs, a notion Perriello has been emphasizing. I don’t think it’s going to happen, and if we lose our jobs because of AI, it’s going to be because AI is a financial bubble, and when it collapses we will lose our jobs the old-fashioned way: by getting laid off in a recession.
But my main warning is that we should not get sidetracked.
“Instead of jumping on the bandwagon of these speculative scenarios, we should stay focused on the real big picture, which is the need to defend our democracy, rein in out-of-control executive power, and restore the power of the US Congress.”
If you want a Democratic candidate who actually [has a _plan_](https://us.list-manage.com/16bqWHhjD6c?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) for how we put Congress back on track, then I’m your man.

If you can, [**_I hope you'll split a donation between our grassroots campaigns.**_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19285?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk980&amount=5&t=7&akid=2449%2E124072%2E5Ake0f)

Peter,
Today, I’m asking you to split $5 between my campaign and Roy Cooper.

# [The Quiet Rigging of the American Market](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3260111&post_id=209077736&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA5MDc3NzM2LCJpYXQiOjE3ODU3Njk4OTcsImV4cCI6MTc4ODM2MTg5NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTMyNjAxMTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.6FLVve3qsZR7WQ76vyNB6xiSnee-DBKl_5CRmzDy_jY)

There is a particular kind of powerlessness that doesn't announce itself as a crisis. It shows up as a fee you didn't agree to. A noncompete clause that keeps a hairdresser from working across town. A farmer who has exactly one buyer for her grain and knows it. A small shop whose entire customer base lives inside an algorithm it doesn't control and can't appeal to.
None of these feel like monopoly in the textbook sense. They feel like _just how things are now_.
That feeling is the tell. It means the rules of the market have quietly stopped protecting the people inside them and started protecting whoever already has the most leverage.
For a few years, one person in DC said that out loud from a position that counted. Lina Khan's tenure at the Federal Trade Commission rested on a simple, overdue correction: **concentrated economic power hurts people,** and not only through higher sticker prices. It hurts them through monopolies made by mergers that quietly foreclose competition before anyone notices it's gone. Through platforms and intermediaries that decide who gets access to customers, markets, and data, and change the terms whenever it suits them. Through contracts written so that leaving is never really an option. And through junk fees and deceptive terms that survive - and rake in millions - precisely because no single instance of them looks big enough to fight.
Here is the part that should bother us more than it probably does. Lina Khan was the only one talking about it, but **none of this depended on the FTC**. An agency chair can push enforcement as far as existing law and a friendly court will allow, and no further. **Only Congress can write the deeper fix** --updated merger standards, real platform accountability, enforceable limits on noncompetes and forced arbitration, statutory bans on junk fees--into permanent law.
Congress has had the pen the entire time, and it has mostly left it capped.
**That 's not an accident of bad luck or bad timing. It's a pattern.** Consolidation is allowed to run until a market tips past the point where competition can be rebuilt. Gatekeeper platforms are treated as an unfortunate feature of modern life rather than a regulatory failure to be corrected. Noncompetes and other restrictive terms stay mostly intact because touching them means picking a fight with exactly the industries that fund Congressional campaigns. And the agencies actually charged with enforcement--the FTC, the DOJ's antitrust division--are kept perpetually under-resourced relative to the size and speed of the markets they're supposed to police.
**I don 't think that's mysterious, and I'm not interested in pretending it is.** When the same handful of industries facing merger scrutiny, platform investigations, and contract crackdowns are also writing checks to the people who'd have to legislate against them, the legislating doesn't happen.
That's not a conspiracy theory. It's just how incentives work when nobody in the room is willing to say no to the money.
I've spent two decades doing hands-on work in agriculture, worker-owned businesses, better farming practices, cooperative governance, and food resilience systems, on five continents--helping people build economic structures where power is distributed by design instead of concentrated by default.
The lesson repeats everywhere it's tried: **markets work best for the people in them when no single actor gets to unilaterally set the terms everyone else has to live under.** That's not a radical idea. It's the oldest idea in fair economics. It's also, functionally, what antitrust law is supposed to guarantee at a national scale--and what Congress has let atrophy.
A member of Congress serious about this wouldn't need to invent new theory. The agenda is sitting right there, waiting for legislative will:
* **Stronger merger standards** , with clear presumptions against consolidation that would foreclose future competition--so review happens before a market tips, not after, when reversing it is nearly impossible.
* **Real platform and intermediary rules** that prohibit self-preferencing, discriminatory access, and acquisitions whose entire purpose is buying out the next competitor before it can grow.
* **Worker and small-business protections** that put actual limits on noncompetes, forced arbitration in antitrust disputes, and contract terms designed so the other side can't walk away.
* **Consumer safeguards** with teeth: statutory bans on junk fees, clear disclosure requirements, and penalties for deceptive practices that are big enough to change corporate behavior instead of just being priced in as a cost of doing business.
* And **enforcement capacity** that matches the scale of what's being policed--adequate filing fees, adequate staffing, adequate investigative authority for the DOJ and FTC to actually do the job Congress keeps saying it wants done.

**This is the part of the job I take most seriously, and it 's also the simplest test of whether any of this is real.** My campaign doesn't take corporate PAC money, foreign interests, or defense contractor money--not as a talking point, but because the moment you take that money, you've already made the choice this essay is about, whether you meant to or not. You cannot credibly promise to write merger standards, platform rules, or contract protections while also depending on the industries those rules would constrain.
Fair markets aren't a favor Congress does for the public. They're the **baseline** condition for everyone else's freedom to compete, to leave a bad deal, and to build something without a gatekeeper's permission.
No company should be able to buy, bully, or contract its way into permanent power over the people who depend on it. That's not an anti-business position--it's a pro-competition one, and competition is exactly what lets small businesses, workers, and families get ahead in the first place.
Congress's job was never to micromanage who succeeds. It's to stop durable private power from rigging the rules before anyone else gets a fair turn.
That's the Congress I'm running to be part of.
**Care. Courage. The Constitution.**

Real platform and intermediary rules that prohibit self-preferencing, discriminatory access, and acquisitions whose entire purpose is buying out the next competitor before it can grow. Worker and small-business protections that put actual limits on noncompetes, forced arbitration in antitrust disputes, and contract terms designed so the other side can't walk away. Consumer safeguards with teeth: statutory bans on junk fees, clear disclosure requirements, and penalties for deceptive practices that are big enough to change corporate behavior instead of just being priced in as a cost of doing business. And enforcement capacity that matches the scale of what's being policed--adequate filing fees, adequate staffing, adequate investigative authority for the DOJ and FTC to actually do the job Congress keeps saying it wants done. This is the part of the job I take most seriously, and it 's also the simplest test of whether any of this is real. My campaign doesn't take corporate PAC money, foreign interests, or defense contractor money--not as a talking point, but because the moment you take that money, you've already made the choice this essay is about, whether you meant to or not. You cannot credibly promise to write merger standards, platform rules, or contract protections while also depending on the industries those rules would constrain. Fair markets aren't a favor Congress does for the public. They're the baseline condition for everyone else's freedom to compete, to leave a bad deal, and to build something without a gatekeeper's permission. No company should be able to buy, bully, or contract its way into permanent power over the people who depend on it. That's not an anti-business position--it's a pro-competition one, and competition is exactly what lets small businesses, workers, and families get ahead in the first place. Congress's job was never to micromanage who succeeds. It's to stop durable private power from rigging the rules before anyone else gets a fair turn. That's the Congress I'm running to be part of. He just invited a dozen friends over to his house to pray. But that was enough for the City of University Heights, Ohio, to send him a cease-and-desist letter, urge neighbors to spy on him, deny him tax abatements, and periodically stop collecting his trash. All because an Orthodox Jewish man—whose faith prevents him from driving to synagogue on the Sabbath—gathered with friends to pray in his own home. Lower federal courts dismissed his case, ruling Daniel had to complete a permit process he never should have faced in the first place. Even worse: Daniel learned that if he had obtained the permit, his home would have been designated a house of worship, and his family would no longer be allowed to live there. But the United States Supreme Court just agreed to hear _Grand v. City of University Heights_ —and ADF is on it. What's at stake goes far beyond one man's home. Thirty-one percent of Evangelical Christians meet in home small groups. Orthodox Jewish minyans like Daniel's, house church gatherings, and home Bible studies all depend on the very freedom Daniel is fighting to exercise. If the city prevails, local governments across the country will have a blueprint: label any home religious gathering a zoning violation, bury the resident in red tape, and then argue that federal courts can't step in. That's a free-exercise emergency. ADF attorneys—alongside co-counsel Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe—are now preparing to argue before the highest court in the land that Americans cannot be locked out of federal courts simply because officials manufactured a bureaucratic maze around their constitutional rights. **The Founders were clear: You don't need a government permit to pray with friends in your own home.** Your ongoing generosity is what helps put ADF in front of the Supreme Court—please make a gift today to keep cases like Daniel's moving forward. Peter,

Tomorrow, the people of this district will decide what's next. So, before anything else, if you haven't already, **[please take a moment to find your polling place and make your plan to vote.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136535065/637772961/1036245226?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGI0MGFkNWMtNGU4Zi1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=cmJHCJ9kLh4bGHFzPwhVs_aWRIqUQpdsAR7WtjGkby0=&emci=9a58e2c8-e38c-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=4b40ad5c-4e8f-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=1020964)**

Every vote matters, _and I hope you'll make yours count._

Peter, this campaign has given me the chance to spend time in neighborhoods all across St. Louis.

I've met parents working two jobs to support their families, small business owners pouring everything they have into their communities, seniors who just want to know someone is looking out for them, and young people who still believe the government can make a difference.

I love St. Louis.

This community shaped me, gave me opportunities I never take for granted, and taught me that when we look out for one another, there's nothing we can't accomplish together. That's why this campaign has never been about politics for politics' sake. It's about the people who call this place home. It's about making sure every family has a fair shot, every child has the chance to succeed, and every neighborhood has someone willing to fight for it.

Now, we're almost at the finish line, but these final hours before tomorrow are some of the most important of the entire campaign. Reaching every last voter before Primary Election Day TOMORROW takes resources, and this campaign is powered by people giving what they can because they believe in this district and what we can accomplish together.

| **Dear Friend** , We are thrilled to announce that **_U.S. House Majority Leader Steve Scalise_** will be a **special guest speaker** at **Congresswoman Sheri Biggs’ inaugural “Salute to Liberty” event** on**Monday, August 17, 2026,** at the**Anderson Sports & Entertainment Center!**
Steve Scalise – the U.S. House Majority Leader and one of President Donald J. Trump’s strongest allies in Congress – is a nationally recognized conservative leader in the Republican Party. A steadfast voice for the America First agenda, he has dedicated his career to advancing conservative principles, strengthening our nation, and defending the values that make America exceptional. \---> [[RESERVE YOUR SEAT NOW]](https://cgnb9.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE8LKR1aS8hLy79hgJG6R/0KKD5bds7BCP) <\--- Congresswoman Sheri Biggs said the following about U.S. House Majority Leader Steve Scalise:
**_“I am honored to welcome House Majority Leader Steve Scalise as a special guest for our 2026 Salute to Liberty,”_** _said Congresswoman Biggs.**“Leader Scalise has spent his career standing for conservative principles, supporting President Trump’s America First agenda, and fighting for the freedoms that make our nation exceptional, while also sharing his unwavering faith even in the most challenging of times. I look forward to welcoming him to South Carolina as we come together to celebrate our nation, honor those who serve, and renew our commitment to defending liberty, and sharing the blessings that God has blessed on our United States of America. You’re not going to want to miss hearing Majority Leader Scalise on Monday, August 17th.”**_ **The Salute to Liberty** will be a patriotic evening honoring the men and women who serve, the principles that founded our Republic, and the enduring spirit of the American people. 🎟 **General admission tickets start at just $30** 🇺🇸 **Veterans, active-duty military, and first responders may attend for just $1.** You're not going to want to miss this incredible evening. Tickets are limited, so please reserve yours today!
**_~ Team Sheri Biggs for Congress_**
