clean_body: | | | | | Peter, it’s John James. I wanted to introduce myself. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. I promise I will not waste your time. I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted. I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, I would live it. Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army. During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud. After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician... I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents. Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024. Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate. My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, but they’re not my #1 reason why... These three kids are the reason why I’m sending this message to you, as a Republican and father running to be the next governor of Michigan Having my own family taught me more lessons than I could list, and it was the one thing being in the U.S. Army didn’t prepare me for. But it also awoke in me a desire to do EVERYTHING and ANYTHING I can to ensure my kids have bright futures. My family means everything to me, and Michigan is our home; that’s why I will fight like my life depends on it to save this state and win this November. I’m under no illusions; I know this election will be one of the toughest challenges I’ve faced in my entire life, but after everything I’ve done in my service, it’s nothing I can’t handle. Unfortunately, the one thing I can’t directly control is spending, and the Democrats will do everything in their power to stop my campaign from making it to the ballot box this November. Nothing can stop us from saving this country if we stand together. Today, I’m asking you to make a small-dollar gift of $10, $25, $50 or ANYTHING you can spare to fuel my campaign’s fight as we approach our upcoming primary election. Thank you for taking the time to read my message. I hope to hear from you in the days to come. #### _**[Endless Urgency exists because people like you choose to support independent media--not billionaires, corporations, or political insiders. Every paid subscription helps our small team earn a livable wage, reach more people, and keep holding the powerful accountable while keeping this work free for everyone. If you believe in what we're building, we'd love to have you with us. It's just $8/month, and every subscription truly makes a difference.](https://substack.com/redirect/c84ae2de-0a96-42f1-baee-e8ef2d404f23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_

* * *
A month ago I was in New York on a run of media hits -- ostensibly to talk about Graham Platner, our Senate candidate in Maine who'd been accused of abusing women and was obviously going to have to drop out. But the clip of mine on Fox News that went the most viral wasn't really about Platner. It was me railing about the double standard in American politics. Because while every Republican was gleeful watching Democrats squirm over a terrible candidate we'd elevated, not one of them would say a single word about Max Miller. And in hindsight, I think that conversation exposed a rot that runs deeper than Republican hypocrisy.
Max Miller is a sitting Republican congressman from Ohio with close ties to Donald Trump, credibly accused by his ex-wife of abuse -- including beating his own young daughter. It seems abundantly clear at this point: he beat them and he lied about it. He broke his daughter's collarbone. His daughter called daddy's house scary. And here's how Miller decided to defend himself on camera yesterday: "If I had assaulted her, would she have offered to cook me dinner six days later?" Then, in the same breath: "I'm not getting out of this race."
So on top of being a woman beater and a drug addict, he's also a fucking moron. How the hell does he think that helps his cause? This is a typical abuser excuse and it makes no sense. Platner at least had the decency to get out; Miller's daring them to make him -- and not a single Republican politician has called for him to resign or be expelled from Congress. Every one of them, and every pundit too, should be asked on the record whether they think he should be gone. They were giddy to talk about Platner. They're awfully fucking quiet now.
That's what set me off on Fox News. I turned to the guest I was debating and asked why nobody in their party cared about any of this. And I had them absolutely shook -- because they know they can't speak out about the predators in their own party when the predator-in-chief is Donald Trump. A man who had to pay E. Jean Carroll more than $5 million because he was found civilly liable for sexually assaulting her -- when what should have actually happened is that he should be in prison right now, full stop.
The double standard is what disgusts me. And that's exactly why I had zero problem going on TV and answering question after question about Graham Platner. He's a scumbag. He should have dropped out, and I was one of the first to say so -- same as I said about Eric Swalwell. But I don't want rules that only apply to Democrats. We cannot be the only party that cares about this, and the media cannot keep treating us differently just because Republicans wake up every single morning and genuinely do not give a damn who they hurt on the way to power -- all so they can cut taxes for billionaires and line Donald Trump's back pocket.
That's what eats at me. Max Miller isn't an exception, either. He's part of a pattern. When it's a Democrat, the coverage is enormous, because the MAGA media machine grabs it and runs. When it's one of their own, silence. And it's not just Trump and Max Miller. It's Cory Mills. It's Ryan Fournier, the founder of Students for Trump, credibly accused of domestic abuse more than once. Corey Lewandowski. Steve Bannon. On and on and on. How many times does this have to happen before there are consequences?
* * *
#### **[If you believe more people need to hear arguments like this, the best way to help is by becoming a paid subscriber. Your support helps our small team keep this work free, independent, and focused on holding the powerful accountable. It's just $8/month, and it genuinely makes a difference.](https://substack.com/redirect/c84ae2de-0a96-42f1-baee-e8ef2d404f23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/c84ae2de-0a96-42f1-baee-e8ef2d404f23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
And here's the thing, guys -- I'm going to keep making this point: I don't think these are partisan issues anymore. I'm tired of seeing everything through a partisan lens. I know I'm your no-BS Democratic strategist, but goddamn it -- almost none of what we actually fight about is partisan anymore. People who put their hands on women or kids should not be allowed anywhere near power. Period. Democrat or Republican. If you're in the Epstein files, I want you prosecuted. If you're credibly accused of assault, I want you gone.
And it goes beyond allegations of abuse. Once you start looking through the lens of accountability, you see the exact same failure _everywhere_.
I've been screaming into the void about the McConnell situation for fifty days now -- and that's not a partisan issue either. It's the same thing that happened with Dianne Feinstein. How many Democratic members have died in office? It's one thing to be mad about Tom Kean disappearing for months, but we need to be equally outraged when it happens inside our own party.
We have real, serious problems in both parties. And the thing we actually need to rally around -- the thing that has fundamentally broken our democracy -- is that there are no consequences for these people anymore. That's the throughline. That's the disease. Everything else is just another symptom. There's no gravity. They can steal whatever they want. They can hurt whoever they want. And they know they will never pay for it.
That problem is bigger than Trump. It existed long before him. He didn't create it--he exploited it.
In fact, Trump has made it dramatically worse, and he keeps exposing the very **rot** of the system, but his MAGA movement is a symptom of a deeper disease. They treat politics like a game they can profit off of, where we each decide what to be outraged about based on the jersey the offender is wearing. That has to stop.
How is it possible that Max Miller -- a man already credibly accused of domestic abuse before he ever got elected -- wins a seat in Congress, then marries the daughter of a sitting Republican senator who, up until yesterday, was too scared to say a damn word about a man accused of beating his own child? How does that happen? How did the voters of Ohio not throw this asshole out? How did his colleagues let it slide?
Because the system protects itself. The staffer class protects the staffer class. The politician class protects the politician class. The donor class protects the donor class. It has to stop. We have to build a broad, wide-reaching coalition to take this country back from the structures rotting it from the inside -- the ones letting so many people get hurt, stripped of their dignity physically, financially, and mentally, every single day, by the worst people among us.
This era of American politics is ending, one way or another. Trump will be gone as will so many others. And I'll be honest: I don't know that what's coming is better. I really don't. But I know we have a chance to make it better. So in a moment like this -- when Max Miller and the Republicans might finally get the media shitstorm they deserve -- we should stop and reflect on how we got here in the first place, and make damn sure it never happens again. Because if Max Miller is just another headline instead of the moment we finally demand consequences, then we'll be right back here with someone else six months from now.

body:
Falling short means we have to make difficult decisions about where to cut back on our budget.
#
Peter,
I’ll be honest with you: last Friday, we missed our end-of-month fundraising goal.
We set a target of raising $50,000 in July to hit the ground running in these final months before the midterm elections. I just endorsed my first slate of candidates this year, and we need these resources to support them.
Falling short means we have to make difficult decisions about where to cut back on our budget. In critical races across the country, a little extra support could go a long way. If we aren’t there, MAGA billionaires get the edge and drown out our voices.
**We can still make up lost ground and start August strong, but only if we act right now.**
This grassroots team has had my back through our toughest fights, and I’m counting on you to come through for us again today.
**[Can you chip in $5 to Small Town PAC to close our fundraising gap and power us into the election season?](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260803-1.4t8cOL&amount=5&refcode=em20260803-928&t=2&akid=928%2E34582%2E3hr1N6)**

Thank you,
Tim

Tim Walz started Small Town PAC to build a Democratic Party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America.
Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. clean_body: When Democratic pro-choice women lead, our country is safer and healthier. | = This should sound alarm bells for all of us, Peter: The United States has already logged more than 2,300 measles cases this year — the highest number in 35 years and more than were reported during all of last year. Measles was declared eliminated from the United States in 2000. Now, this dangerous and preventable disease is spreading again as MAGA Republicans like Department of Health and Human Services Secretary RFK Jr. fuel distrust in lifesaving vaccines. Our elected officials should be working to keep us safe. Instead, Republican extremists in the Trump administration and Congress are undermining public health and allowing dangerous misinformation (and dangerous diseases!) to spread. That's why EMILYs List is working to elect Democratic pro-choice women physicians who will bring real medical expertise to office and fight to keep our communities safe and healthy. = | = When a public health crisis strikes, MAGA Republicans are out of their depth. They aren't trained for it. They don't have the medical, scientific, or research-based backgrounds to address the problem. And they are often behind the reckless budget cuts and policy shifts that helped create the crisis in the first place. But doctors know what's at stake. That's why EMILYs List is proud to support Democratic women physicians who will bring real science, experience, and integrity to the fight for public health, including: Dr. Amy Acton (OH-GOV) — A physician and former director of the Ohio Department of Health, Dr. Acton led her state's response during the COVID-19 pandemic when the science was under attack and the stakes were life and death. Her actions influenced other states nationwide and saved countless lives. She's running for governor to fight for every Ohio family that's struggling today. Dr. Annie Andrews (SC-SEN) — A practicing pediatrician who has spent her career caring for children, including those suffering from vaccine-preventable diseases, Dr. Andrews is running to bring that firsthand experience to the Senate and hold the Trump administration accountable. | | | | |

| Tomorrow is the day.
After months of traveling the 7th District, knocking on doors, making calls, attending events, and building an incredible grassroots movement, we're just one final push away. Now it's time to WIN. 🇺🇸
This campaign has never been about one person--it has been about thousands of Virginians who believe our district deserves strong leadership, common-sense solutions, and someone who will fight every single day for our communities.

## 🗳️ VOTE TOMORROW
Make a plan to vote before you go to work, during lunch, or on your way home.
Then do one more thing... 👉 Bring a friend. 👉 Call your family. 👉 Text your neighbors. One conversation could make all the difference.

This is it.
Every dollar helps us finish strong.

body:
Make your plan, go out to the polls, and vote Dave Beckwith!
| | | | Hi Friend,
**Election Day is tomorrow, Tuesday, August 4th.**

Polls are open from 6am to 7pm, and if you're in line by 7pm, you're still guaranteed to vote.
Not sure where to go? Find your polling location here: [www.elections.virginia.gov/casting-a-ballot/polling-place-lookup/](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress._Gw/s4icfde9298)
Take a minute today to make your plan: know where you're voting and when you'll go, whether that's first thing in the morning, on your lunch break, or right after work.
I'm running for Congress to restore faith in the American Dream for every family in VA-10, and tomorrow is how that fight moves forward. I'd be honored to earn your vote.
**Vote Dave Beckwith for Congress TOMORROW!**

See you at the polls!

clean_body: Maryland families deserve a Comptroller who puts taxpayers first | | | | | | | | | | | | | Marylander, For too long, waste , fraud, and abuse have drained resources that should serve families, schools, public safety, and essential services. Billions of dollars move through the state government with insufficient oversight. The result is higher costs , tighter budgets , and declining public trust. | | I am running for Comptroller to change that. As your Independent Taxpayer Watchdog, I will:✅ Aggressively root out fraud, waste, and abuse✅ Strengthen procurement oversight and demand real accountability ✅ Deliver transparent reporting so every Marylander can see where their money goesI’m a businesswoman, retired military spouse, and the daughter of a single mother who taught me the value of every dollar. I will bring that same discipline and integrity to Annapolis. The general election is November 3. The fight against waste starts now and requires resources to win.Stand with me and help protect Maryland families by making a contribution today! | | | Maryland deserves leadership that treats public money with the same care responsible families treat their own. Join me in restoring accountability and trust. Thank you for standing up for fiscal responsibility. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Let’s Get It DUNN,Sonya Dunn Republican Nominee for Maryland ComptrollerMaryland’s Money. # [First U.S.-Japan yen intervention in 28 years shocks markets](https://substack.com/redirect/e69f7611-568a-44b4-a336-cf68eebe062f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The U.S. and Japan confirmed a coordinated **[Yen-buying intervention Friday, the first joint operation since 1998,](https://substack.com/redirect/d30000ed-2510-43d3-8479-ef8cb92b393b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the currency hit 163.73 per dollar and both sides signaled they will not hesitate to act again.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/63d709e4-81f2-4474-8373-6ba53c4d776c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Both sides signal readiness:** Japan's Finance Ministry and U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent **[confirmed Friday's action countered disorderly yen moves](https://substack.com/redirect/81ee1868-b2a0-4258-8593-adfb082efe0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and said both sides will not hesitate to conduct further coordinated interventions.
* **Large scale yen buys:** Bank of Japan data showed Japan may have bought as much as $58.97 billion of yen on Thursday, **[helping drive a more than 3% surge over two sessions and a 1% rise to 156.01 Monday.](https://substack.com/redirect/771f5e63-aebe-4d51-8d1b-79462b463a80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Treasury market concerns raised:** Analysts cited U.S. worries that Japan, as the largest foreign holder of Treasurys, might dump bonds to fund unilateral action, so the Fed FIMA repo facility will be used instead.
* **Euro sale questions raised:** **[Reports the U.S. sold euros rather than dollars](https://substack.com/redirect/a884ea01-bf05-451e-abb8-19cbda4c7884?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to buy yen surprised markets, with Robin Brooks arguing this twist undercuts the efficacy of American participation in the intervention.

* * *
* * *
# [$89 million in Bitcoin vanishes from "secure" Coldcard wallets](https://substack.com/redirect/e69f7611-568a-44b4-a336-cf68eebe062f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**[A software flaw in Coldcard bitcoin hardware wallets is linked to the theft of nearly $89 million](https://substack.com/redirect/dfa8280e-a950-4bf5-b505-b502a299757a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from more than 1,200 addresses after attackers exploited predictable recovery phrases, with the maker urging immediate fund migration.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e69f7611-568a-44b4-a336-cf68eebe062f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive rapid theft:** Galaxy Research reported more than 1,000 bitcoin drained from 1,196 wallets in 41 minutes on July 30, with additional waves pushing estimated losses to nearly $89 million.
* **Predictable seed phrases:** A coding mistake in certain firmware versions weakened key security features, making some recovery phrases predictable enough for sophisticated attackers to steal funds remotely.
* **Maker issues update:** Coinkite released a software fix for new wallets but warned existing seeds remain vulnerable and users must generate brand-new recovery phrases then migrate their bitcoin.
* **CEO takes accountability:** Coinkite CEO Rodolfo Novak apologized, saying the team is heartbroken and taking full accountability while urging customers to act immediately as attacks remain ongoing.

# [ChatGPT grabs nearly 88% of all House AI spending](https://substack.com/redirect/e69f7611-568a-44b4-a336-cf68eebe062f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
OpenAI's **[ChatGPT accounted for about 88% of identifiable House spending](https://substack.com/redirect/e14d7aa6-ee74-44c5-a4b7-d2d95bcb55a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on AI tools in the year ending March 31, appearing in at least 71 member offices as lawmakers debate industry regulation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e69f7611-568a-44b4-a336-cf68eebe062f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **ChatGPT leads spending:** The chatbot generated $100,580 of the $113,740 in named AI vendor purchases across 798 transactions, representing roughly 88% of dollars and 96% of transactions reviewed.
* **Wide office adoption:** ChatGPT purchases appeared in at least 71 House member offices, or roughly 1 in 6, while Anthropic's Claude totaled only $13,160 across 37 transactions.
* **Democrats spend more:** Democratic member offices accounted for $54,165 in identified AI purchases, more than three times the $15,782 spent by Republican offices on the tools.
* **Early OpenAI advantage:** The dominance traces to Congress' first formal AI experiments and training partnerships that made ChatGPT the first product many offices knew by name.

# [Nvidia CEO says AI boom delivers six-figure paychecks to trade workers](https://substack.com/redirect/e69f7611-568a-44b4-a336-cf68eebe062f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the AI data-center build-out will unlock a lot of **[six-figure jobs for plumbers, electricians and construction workers](https://substack.com/redirect/5daadaa0-a1b7-4d47-ac14-e29caece8657?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as the largest infrastructure project in human history unfolds.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e69f7611-568a-44b4-a336-cf68eebe062f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trades jobs surge:** Huang told BlackRock CEO Larry Fink at Davos that the AI boom is creating six-figure opportunities in plumbing, construction, electricians and steelworkers to build new AI centers.
* **Infrastructure scale huge:** Tech giants are racing toward $7 trillion in global capital outlays for data centers by the end of the decade, described as the largest infrastructure build-out in human history.
* **Skilled worker shortages:** McKinsey estimated the U.S. will need an additional 130,000 electricians, 240,000 construction laborers and 150,000 supervisors between 2023 and 2030.
* **No degree required:** Huang emphasized that everyone should be able to make a great living and that a PhD in computer science is not needed for these high-paying roles.

Palantir shares rose more than 2% in premarket trading Monday ahead of fiscal second-quarter results after the bell, with **[investors focused on commercial progress and Pentagon contracts.](https://substack.com/redirect/cb74341e-185c-43a5-93f9-e6015c36300f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---

* **Commercial focus key:** Investors will watch progress on commercial agreements that have accelerated this year along with renewals of overseas contracts.
* **Pentagon role expands:** Earlier this year the company's Maven Smart System became an official Pentagon program of record, locking in a bigger role in U.S. military AI projects.

# [Musk's SpaceX hits all-time stock low before earnings](https://substack.com/redirect/e69f7611-568a-44b4-a336-cf68eebe062f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
SpaceX will r**[eport its first earnings as a public company Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/a4b8bf9c-6b22-4f68-9e18-f18105c2a393?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the bell with shares at a new all-time low after plunging more than 50% from the post-IPO high and a large lockup unlock days away.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e69f7611-568a-44b4-a336-cf68eebe062f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Stock hits new low:** Shares **[reached a new all-time low Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/aed2333f-cd40-43cb-bb0d-3df67fcc5eff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after **[falling more than 50% from the $225.64 high](https://substack.com/redirect/61d17386-2781-4f97-98b3-121374938be4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and nearly 30% from the $150 debut, erasing over $500 billion in market value since the June IPO.
* **Major lockup unlock:** On Aug. 6 the lockup frees 911.5 million shares, more than the current 640 million float and up to 20% of the company, raising fears of heavy selling by early holders.
* **Earnings numbers expected:** Consensus forecasts Q2 revenue of $6.87 billion up from $4.7 billion, an adjusted loss of $0.25 per share and adjusted EBITDA of $2.03 billion amid rising capital spending.
* **Analysts divided on outlook:** Some call the drop an attractive entry with enormous growth and a wide moat while short sellers have booked about $8.3 billion in paper profits since the IPO.

standing in front of the U.S. Capitol.

Right now, MAGA is quickly losing ground in districts they used to take
for granted. And it’s happening because of inspiring candidates who are
not afraid to speak to what people ACTUALLY need.

In Ohio’s 7th, union ironworker Brian Poindexter is connecting with voters
on the cost of living crisis. He’s facing Max Miller, whose national
headlines include allegations of domestic violence and child abuse. It’s
working – a poll just found the race tied in a district Trump won by
double digits last cycle.

In Pennsylvania, Bob Brooks used to be on food stamps, lived in public
housing, and put his life on the line as a firefighter. His opponent, Ryan
MacKenzie, is swimming in megadonor money – including cash from a man
involved in the Abramoff fraud and lobbying scandal. Three days after the
donor gave his donation, he got a pardon from Trump.

In California’s 22nd, Randy Villegas beat the Democratic establishment’s
chosen candidate by speaking directly to real solutions for working
families. Now he’s facing down the GOP in a crucial House battleground –
holding the incumbent accountable on health care, wages, and the climate
disasters that are already hitting farmworkers hard.

And in Montana, the DCCC has moved the 1st District onto the “Red to Blue”
list. Sam Forstag jumped from planes into wildfires, then became a union
leader, and now he’s running against right-wing radio personality Aaron
Flint. Sam’s message is clear: we must “fix a system where working people
fall further behind while the rich get richer.”

These are the candidates we’re mobilizing to support. We’re knocking doors
in places other organizations don’t bother with, talking to neglected
voters, and changing minds with real stories and real solutions. With your
support, we can win where it matters most, and flip the House for people,
not big donors.

Every door
knocked, every call made, every vote won depends on your support.

When we organize, we win.

It is why she has fought to protect lifesaving healthcare for trans kids and stood against Trump pouring billions into an ICE detention system that locks up children and families. And it is why she refuses to look away when children are being bombed, starved, displaced, or denied a future. All kids means all kids. Trans kids. Immigrant kids trapped in ICE detention. Kids in Vermont, across the United States, in Israel, in Gaza, and in Iran. ALL kids. Becca has pushed for a ceasefire, the release of the hostages, humanitarian aid, and an end to U.S. support that fuels more death and suffering. And she has done it even when speaking out came with a political cost. = Ms. Rachel has faced relentless attacks for using her platform to defend Palestinian children. And Becca knows something about that. She knows what it feels like to be targeted for standing by your values. She also knows the answer cannot be silence. But Becca did not go to Congress to learn how to look away. She went to fight for a world where children can attend school without fearing a bullet, see a doctor without bankrupting their parents, eat a full meal before, during AND after school, sleep beneath a safe roof, live openly as exactly who they are, and grow up without bombs falling around them. Ms. Rachel put Becca’s name on a very short list because she knows Becca has the kindness to care about every child and the courage to keep fighting for them. Now we need to make sure Becca can keep doing that work. = With courage and kindness, — Team Becca If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = mailto:beccabalintvt@beccabalint.com | Paid for by Becca Balint for Vermont P.O. They see our momentum. They see this coalition.

If the people who care about this mission don’t step in now, if they assume “someone else” will handle it, we won’t have what we need to keep pushing forward.
**If we slip behind here, we risk losing __EVERYTHING__ _._**
That’s why I’m reaching out to _**YOU**_ personally, Friend.
I’m not asking for something huge. Not a big sacrifice.
**[Just a simple, meaningful $5. The kind of small step that becomes something powerful when enough people take it together.](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)**

Everything feels faster , heavier , and more urgent than it did even a month ago. And here’s what keeps me up at night: If the people who care about this mission don’t step in now, if they assume “someone else” will handle it, we won’t have what we need to keep pushing forward. If we slip behind here, we risk losing EVERYTHING . That’s why I’m reaching out to YOU personally, Friend. I’m not asking for something huge. Not a big sacrifice. If you can, I’m asking from the heart: Chip in $5 today. # Big News: DNC Is Unifying Our Ecosystem With ASDC, Swing Left, & DDx
---
| |
We are thrilled to share a major milestone in how our party and partner organizations organize, engage voters, and win elections up and down the ballot. The **Democratic National Committee (DNC)** , alongside the **Association of State Democratic Committees (ASDC)** , the **Democratic Data Exchange (DDx)** , and **Swing Left** , has officially struck a landmark, first-of-its-kind agreement to seamlessly share real-time voter contact data across the entire progressive ecosystem.
_"The DNC is committed to organizing year-round, ensuring Democrats up and down the ballot have the infrastructure to win in 2026, 2028, and beyond. We are proud to partner with Democratic Data Exchange and Swing Left to put critical, ground-level voter data directly into the hands of campaigns nationwide."_ — **Catherine Tarsney Kahle** , DNC Chief Technology Officer

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

body:

Today marks the one year anniversary of when my Texas House colleagues and I broke quorum to stop Greg Abbott and Texas Republicans from forcing through _rigged_ mid-decade redistricting.
I wasn’t going to sit back and just let that happen. My colleagues and I got up and fought back.
We put a national spotlight on what Republicans were doing. And we showed the country what it looks like to stand up when democracy is on the line.
Despite the Supreme Court clearing the way for Republicans’ rigged maps, we haven’t given up this fight. Because Abbott and his allies aren’t done. They’ve promised to come back next year and rig the maps all over again. And they’re already eyeing when Texas gains 4-5 more seats by the end of this decade.
That is exactly how Republicans try to hold onto power when they know voters are turning on them. They redraw the lines, causing chaos in the midst of important elections.

Dear Friend,Today is an important day for Alaska, early voting for the August 18 primary election officially begins! We encourage you to make a plan to cast your vote and we’d be honored to earn it.
We also want to invite you to join us Tuesday, August 4, at 7:00 PM for a virtual town hall. This is not a fundraiser; it is an opportunity for us to have a real discussion about Alaska’s future.
We will be presenting our blueprint for building the gasline, addressing fiscal and energy crises, and proposing an annual, true resource-based PFD. Our focus is on solutions, not slogans.
Event Details:• When: Tuesday, August 4, at 7:00 PM• Where: Live-streamed on Facebook at [facebook.com/BillWalker.AK](http://facebook.com/BillWalker.AK)
No need to bring a checkbook, bring your questions. We look forward to seeing you there and hearing your thoughts on the path forward for the Alaska we love.
All Alaska, All the time!

---
Derek, you need to see this: [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260803_8386_fr&amount=7&refcode2=8386_22930333_qVbptu&akid=8386%2E22930333%2EqVbptu) These races are already neck-and-neck, and Democrats need to win _all_ of them if we want to take back the Senate this year and put a major check on Trump’s destructive agenda. name: Adam Dunigan
subject: A Rare Moment of Sincerity
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Adam for Congress[Vote](http://adam4congress
body:
I want to introduce you all to our team.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | |
Hey everyone, Adam here.
No silly subject line today. Not begging for money. I hope you’ll permit me to be sentimental today:
Polls open tomorrow at 6 AM, and I hope I have your vote. But if you need a few more reasons, allow me to introduce you, below, to the real heroes of the republic: The Adam for Congress campaign family.

Coming from my previous line of work, it can be hard to trust others. You’re often alone. You keep your life small, contained. But over the last seven months, I have never been alone. I have found myself in constant company of incredible people in the struggle to reclaim this country. This campaign has attracted some of the weirdest, most sincere, and occasionally unsound group of misfits ever assembled in federal politics.
None of them knew I was saving these photos, or would write this up for our last day of the campaign. I hope they forgive me for outing them. They aren’t “staff.” They aren’t “volunteers.” They’re my friends. I owe them everything, and it’s a debt I aim to repay. This is our story.
-Adam
---
| | So this campaign started back in January. Skies were dark, air was crisp. I had just resigned from CIA. I was a complete political unknown. Just me, the wind, and Jack Frost to start off. Because I’m wearing sunglasses, you can’t see the look of “ _oh my god what have I done to my life why did I run for office”_ in my eyes.
__But a crew began to form. Using the age-old spycraft technique of “being really annoying and begging a lot and crying in public,” people slowly began to approximate to the cause. I’m going to avoid naming most people in these photos, because privacy. But admire this photo for the fact that it was like 15 degrees and these people have warm homes and families they could be with. And yet, there they are with me, in the cold, fighting for a brighter future. And fight on, we did. Through speeches and canvassing and grey weather and cold. Not just cold weather, but cold rooms. It’s thankless work, challenging the establishment. From combative committees, to other candidates buying my name rights online, to death threats online, we endured.And the weather warmed eventually. Ee found ourselves under sunnier skies. Not just meteorologically speaking either; rooms were warmer as well. We had more people following us, more people receptive to our message, and more people around the Commonwealth taking notice. That included other candidates, like Tim Cywinski down in Virginia’s first district. We slept on each other’s couches when we visited each other’s towns. He knows our crew, we know his. There’s one particularly impressive young woman who works on both of our campaigns. How she retains her sanity doing two campaigns at once is a constant marvel.
When I met Tim, I also met Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs. Those two are actually running against each other, but they’re friends and they’re more committed to the republic than their own vanity, so they do what it takes. Above is a picture of me and Tim looking like weird political step brothers. And here’s Elizabeth, giving me the universal greeting of friendship and common bond:A good evening to you as well, Madame Candidate!__These last months have been marked by aggressive ground game. We had crews just like this running daily around the district. In the immortal words of Herodotus:_“Neither snow nor rain nor gloom of night could stay these couriers from the swift completion of their appointed rounds.”_ __Up and down Virginia’s 8th, they rode from town to town, the battle cry echoing off buildings and hillsides. They were with me every step of the way. When I was low, they carried me. Good days and bad. They saved me from them the depths of panic attacks before speeches, they feted me in raucous dive bars after each victory. We built something amazing, and everyone could feel it.
I had no idea what I was doing. But they believed in me. That gave me clarity.__We attended all sorts of events, from sports, to politics, to poetry, to protests, to pickleball. In the photo above, you can see me learning in real time that, for some reason, it’s totally acceptable in society to make your children do physical combat for your entertainment. Kinda weird, parents, but ok.__I even gave a TEDx Talk at GMU? Pretty wild. My presentation was weird and I was way too nervous; nobody should watch it. But Sarena, front left in the boots, was instrumental in giving us the opportunity. She came to our campaign via another personal friend, Luke Nathan Phillips. He briefly ran for the Republican nomination, and gave me one of the[coolest, most unexpected experiences on the campaign](https://www.reddit.com/r/arlingtonva/comments/1t99pew/fun_anecdote_from_arlingtons_historyfest_and_the/). We may disagree on a lot, but that doesn’t cloud my ability to recognize a true friend and citizen of the Republic. I’ll never forget that. But far and away, the best moments on this campaign were the quiet moments. The time spent away from the noise and the motion. Where we could all look back and marvel at how far we’d come. This is Lisa and I. Lisa has been there beside me from day 1. She’s one of the toughest, smartest, and impressive people I’ve ever met. She should probably be running instead of me. She reminds me of that occasionally, but I’ll do for now, she says.
I have thousands of other pictures I’d like to put here, but I’ll save them for something more coherent after we see what happens. For now, there’s just two more special mentions: Theodore “Ted” “Tedward” Stanton, and Jacob “The Wunderkind of Northern Virginia Politics” Williams. Ted’s our photographer, Jake is my long-suffering manager and housecarl. Everyone should take pity on both of these boys. I am difficult to photograph, and I am, by nature, unmanageable. Here’s Ted. He says he prefers I don’t put him in these too much, as he doesn’t like to interfere with the subject of his work. Such an artist. But out of respect for his wishes, I’ll just use this photo, which I believe shows his professionalism, stoic demeanor, and intellectual posture.And here’s our boy, Jake. With an expression that can only say, “goddamnit, what weird stuff did Adam post online now?”And to close out, I leave you with lil ol’ me. Here I am, giving my speech just a few weeks ago to the local committee. As you can see, one of my enthusiastic supporters, just beyond me, triumphantly holds up her sign proclaiming, “TIME’S UP” for the Democratic Establishment. Yes, ma’am. Indeed.
Thank you to everyone who came along on this Dickensian journey. We started 7 months ago, from nothing, and look how far we’ve come. And we’re just getting started. Whatever happens tomorrow, I have a feeling we’re about to change the goddamn world either way.
As for me? After years adrift in a very different kind of life, you all finally brought me home. There’s an old Irish toast that goes, “may your house always be too small to fit all your friends.” I know now that mine shall ever be.
Shine on, you crazy diamonds. Shine on.
---

I had no idea what I was doing. But they believed in me. That gave me clarity.We attended all sorts of events, from sports, to politics, to poetry, to protests, to pickleball. In the photo above, you can see me learning in real time that, for some reason, it’s totally acceptable in society to make your children do physical combat for your entertainment. Kinda weird, parents, but ok.I even gave a TEDx Talk at GMU? Pretty wild. My presentation was weird and I was way too nervous; nobody should watch it. But Sarena, front left in the boots, was instrumental in giving us the opportunity. She came to our campaign via another personal friend, Luke Nathan Phillips. He briefly ran for the Republican nomination, and gave me one of the. We may disagree on a lot, but that doesn’t cloud my ability to recognize a true friend and citizen of the Republic. I’ll never forget that. But far and away, the best moments on this campaign were the quiet moments. The time spent away from the noise and the motion. Where we could all look back and marvel at how far we’d come. This is Lisa and I. Lisa has been there beside me from day 1. She’s one of the toughest, smartest, and impressive people I’ve ever met. She should probably be running instead of me. She reminds me of that occasionally, but I’ll do for now, she says. I have thousands of other pictures I’d like to put here, but I’ll save them for something more coherent after we see what happens. For now, there’s just two more special mentions: Theodore “Ted” “Tedward” Stanton, and Jacob “The Wunderkind of Northern Virginia Politics” Williams. Ted’s our photographer, Jake is my long-suffering manager and housecarl. Everyone should take pity on both of these boys. I am difficult to photograph, and I am, by nature, unmanageable. Here’s Ted. He says he prefers I don’t put him in these too much, as he doesn’t like to interfere with the subject of his work. Such an artist. But out of respect for his wishes, I’ll just use this photo, which I believe shows his professionalism, stoic demeanor, and intellectual posture.And here’s our boy, Jake. With an expression that can only say, “goddamnit, what weird stuff did Adam post online now?”And to close out, I leave you with lil ol’ me. Here I am, giving my speech just a few weeks ago to the local committee. As you can see, one of my enthusiastic supporters, just beyond me, triumphantly holds up her sign proclaiming, “TIME’S UP” for the Democratic Establishment. Yes, ma’am. Indeed. Thank you to everyone who came along on this Dickensian journey. We started 7 months ago, from nothing, and look how far we’ve come. And we’re just getting started. Whatever happens tomorrow, I have a feeling we’re about to change the goddamn world either way. As for me? After years adrift in a very different kind of life, you all finally brought me home. There’s an old Irish toast that goes, “may your house always be too small to fit all your friends.” I know now that mine shall ever be. Shine on, you crazy diamonds. Shine on. | | Your friend,Adam Dunigan Congressional CandidateVirginia's 8th District | | Resources and Links | | Recent Media Appearances== | | | | | | Paid for by Adam for Congress | | | | | | | or |

Peter,

After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, _**but I am ready.**_

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times.

I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for.

I did not seek this moment, Peter.

clean_body: | Peter, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Peter. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. We have less than 2 weeks to run against people who have been at this for years. Since you were there for Lindsey, Thank you for everything you did for Lindsey over the years. I know that having people like you in his corner meant everything to him. God bless, Darline Graham P.S. It's been a difficult few weeks. I never thought I'd be in this position, but I am ready to answer the call from President Trump. I am ready to run. | | Paid for by Darline for Senate Don't want to receive any more of our emails? On August 29, we join Olivia Rodrigo at Daisy Chain Fields, a festival built on a simple idea: joy, community, and creativity can drive real change.

We believe that too. [Every day, we fight in courtrooms and legislatures across the globe for a better future—one where all of us, no matter where we live, can decide our own paths.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/136551062/637816963/1613143181?sourceid=1151515&utm_campaign=27emcus-0702aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=dcf&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OWY0YTA4YS02OThmLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=c0WsYjNwF-crICiZ6qahlWAyDQUetFQxXT30g_m8Cdg=&emci=2323d829-a48b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=79f4a08a-698f-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=954237)

Right now, too many people don't have that freedom. In the U.S., access to abortion and other reproductive health care depends entirely on your zip code. Anti-abortion extremists work every day to pass harsh new restrictions.

We teamed up with Olivia Rodrigo for an Instagram takeover to talk about abortion bans, midwifery, and the maternal health crisis. name: Letitia James
subject: They want to silence us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Demand Justice PAC
body:
This is our country, and I'll be damned if they ruin it.

This administration wants to exert its power over our great state —
bringing their routine of lawlessness, hatred, and intimidation right to
our front door.

They want to tear down everything we've built, target our most vulnerable
neighbors, and rule through fear and cruelty.

As long as I'm Attorney General of New York, I won't let them. Not now.
Not ever.

The justice system is one of the last lines of defense we have against
this administration’s cruel agenda. It stands between them and the
vulnerable people they're targeting — immigrants, communities of color,
working families, and anyone who dares to speak truth to power.

I’ve spent my entire career using the law as a sword and a shield. I've
used that sword against the NRA, predatory landlords, and the president
every time he’s abused his power. And I've used that shield to protect
tenants, immigrants, everyday New Yorkers, and anyone else who needed a
fighter in their corner.

That's exactly why the bad actors want this office in their pocket —
they're afraid of being held accountable for their corruption. They've
seen what happens when I take on the powerful, and they want me gone. They
want an Attorney General who will look the other way while they line their
pockets and trample on the rights of everyday people.

But I am not afraid of them. I never have been.

We can win this race and keep delivering justice in New York and across
the country. But we must be courageous. And we must be united.

the wealthy and well-connected, will you split a donation between my

Peter,

After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, _**but I am ready.**_

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times.

I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for.

I did not seek this moment, Peter.

But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. **[However, I cannot do this alone.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=8198b9715fa648fead3a1f3cbf1d08ab&_e=9DptLRg8bdeFlDYNzUyKEFtPqZDFGMecvA90EWzAI70tSoANZSHc0rCBfRKxwOe39sjtx3InAuf5eOx6tnY24aGLSjxDPVL7s_ois2cOZJwUg9K8Ltb_I4LsbexT-f53dHmukjZnDmAb65gZp6H2qq1KD7yJnK8EBRDWeqdqCO1632tJqWq8lZr-k_7yi5MpDCiwbUjcZuQT1hN1DW1h3Mpz9hNvTaYlGbtg-xuqp8n4jh5-IlCbn1pju4gBtrocCHacS4bVFZVke-ziFLsBsXke7GzcFlxW9x6y9ScMofyEZoG7SbQ0b077jAD_jIV7itA94oAbU1OD3ZLvyxbS4pozjNAg8fWUd1QxB5N0ZeC5XhYgNKiNwggEZd0NDZs3-QBuY9fTXWmbbhPVohdEI8LpK1qaUbdEud2skzVyF8vk0bRCEEhK1XRcsfD7dzaFb6fD-hbHkF8uDU-WajF-4d41qZX9SYS46iCsECTCvWDxzyz8Y_TzZsywzAV02zg0jmeTOI7PlskEGtNeJRj7nQXs1cL14tCCF7J1pD43J34OpLglRL3V0OYgzaNZ1dVNgXsdU2DqhWIkSoNordUH7LluJGbx3e7ATUpaWTd6W8tZhYA4IQ9JXejhgRz7AzkSORYLSqAAi17Pg7VN0101l_s_gVSAGrXkOAQvXCKXwgOnzGdN_LXi0TdoR5Ch5oACR0rU_RK8WCF56NCw6WfWD7BiHaVi_tsdkHhLetR0jREbxybMEbmlRzGzA097QSywaKkUvyoHM7qi9OqIQvCMVAOXjdTD0TWCgUBfG2l_nt4%3D)**

clean_body: I'm ready for the fight ahead, and I'm all in to run for the United States Senate. | Peter, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Peter. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. We have less than 2 weeks to run against people who have been at this for years. Since you were there for Lindsey, Thank you for everything you did for Lindsey over the years. I know that having people like you in his corner meant everything to him. God bless, Darline Graham P.S. It's been a difficult few weeks. I never thought I'd be in this position, but I am ready to answer the call from President Trump. **August 3, 2026** **MONDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
**This past Saturday, Colorado turned 150 years old.**
It's a birthday worth celebrating—but it's also one that calls for honest reflection.
When Colorado became the 38th state in 1876, it earned its reputation as the Wild West. It was a place defined by independence, self-reliance, entrepreneurship, and the belief that if you worked hard enough, you could build a better life.
For generations, people came here chasing opportunity.
Today, too many are leaving because they no longer see it.
Colorado has become one of the most expensive states in the country. Businesses continue to relocate. Families are struggling to afford the communities they grew up in. Crime has become a growing concern in many parts of the state. And nationally, Colorado has become known less for its rugged independence and more for being first in the nation to adopt some of the country's most progressive policies—from expansive abortion laws and marijuana legalization to controversial legislation involving gender identity and minors.
Whether you celebrate those changes or oppose them, few would argue Colorado looks the same as it did even a decade ago.
After years of one-party control at the Capitol, the direction of the state is no longer an accident. It is the product of policy choices.
_**That's why Rocky Mountain Voice exists.**_ Not because we believe Colorado is beyond saving. But because we believe it's worth saving.
We believe Colorado's best days weren't behind us—they're still ahead, if enough people are willing to get involved.
That starts with telling the stories too often overlooked by legacy media. It means asking difficult questions, holding elected officials accountable regardless of title or party, and giving everyday Coloradans a voice in conversations that shape their communities.
It also means remembering who we are. Colorado isn't just Denver. It's ranchers on the Eastern Plains. Small business owners on Main Street. Energy workers on the Western Slope. Parents fighting for their children's future. Teachers, veterans, first responders, farmers, entrepreneurs, and neighbors who may disagree politically but still love this state deeply.
If there's one thing Freedom Fest reminded us, it's this: _**Thousands of Coloradans are hungry for something better.**_
They're hungry for truth over talking points. Community over division. Hope over cynicism. And a Colorado that once again rewards hard work, protects families, respects individual liberty, and gives the next generation every reason to stay.
As Colorado begins its next 150 years, our mission remains unchanged. To defend liberty. To tell the stories others won't. To hold government accountable. And to help preserve the Colorado we know is still worth fighting for.
_**Happy 150th Birthday, Colorado.**_ _**The next chapter is still ours to write.**_
In truth & liberty,
Team RMV

subject: When I started my first business, I prayed it would be successful... God answered.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Troy Downing for Congress
body:
When I was deployed to Afghanistan, I prayed my family would be safe...God answered.

[](https://trk.emails.troydowning._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDgwM19FRi1LSC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5NzcxNDUtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA4MDNfRUYtS0guMTEwMTE3X3QxOTc3MTQ1LTI4OTkifQ/3epybP50yLqxY4m9Ulgcyg)God works in mysterious ways...
When I started my first business, I prayed it would be successful... **God answered.**
When I was deployed to Afghanistan, I prayed my family would be safe... **God answered.**
When I saw career politicians turn their backs on Americans to put their pet projects before the interest of the American people, I prayed for a better outcome...
I was surprised when **_God called on ME_** to run for office.
I'm Troy Downing. You might not recognize my name, but that's okay.
I'm a combat veteran. A God-fearing Christian. A husband & a proud dad.
**[I'm also the Republican running for re-election in Congress for Montana in the biggest race in the country.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDgwM19FRi1LSC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5NzcxNDUtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA4MDNfRUYtS0guMTEwMTE3X3QxOTc3MTQ1LTI4OTkifQ/hHPYnaiMltnW6k_XpkIhhQ)**
I'm not in this to become a household name or for the title. I don't care about any of that.
I'm a simple man who enjoys a beer, likes to hunt and fish with my buddies & puts my family before anything else.
**__But I'm at my wits' end with two-faced politicians and DC bigwigs who say one thing to your face, only to turn around & stab hard-working folks like you & me in the back.__**
I'll always tell the truth. I'll always put America first. I'll always stand up for what's right.
The Radical Left will spread lies about me & throw me under the bus just to end my campaign before the midterms.
**[Peter, can you take a leap of faith on a simple combat vet like me to beat the Left & save our country?](https://trk.emails.troydowning._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDgwM19FRi1LSC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5NzcxNDUtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA4MDNfRUYtS0guMTEwMTE3X3QxOTc3MTQ1LTI4OTkifQ/nCY0b-mqPe4vRtrek35qeg)**[HELP A COMBAT VET
](https://trk.emails.troydowning._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDgwM19FRi1LSC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5NzcxNDUtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA4MDNfRUYtS0guMTEwMTE3X3QxOTc3MTQ1LTI4OTkifQ/ZF5j-xoBM5w9lLembPXrZA)I know if we win this race, we can bring the entire Democrat Machine to its knees.
Thank you & God Bless,
Troy Downing (R-MT)| |

As the years went on, the trauma only grew deeper. To survive, she turned to addiction \- the only way to numb the pain. The only way to keep going. She even had children with one of the men who trafficked her. Another chain and reason it felt impossible to escape. For years, she lived in fear. No way out. Until one day, she reached a breaking point. With nothing but courage and fear in her heart, she ran, fleeing to a women's shelter. No plan. No safety.
**Just hope that maybe someone would help her. ** **And that is when everything began to change. ****Because someone did show up. **A partner of the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** called House Parent Project. They didn't turn her away. They didn't question her worth. **They sat with her, they listened and believed her. And in that moment, light entered her story. **

They helped her take the next step.Then the next. And the next. They safely relocated her far from the people who had controlled her life. **For the first time in years, she could breathe.** She could begin to heal. But they didn't stop there. They are still walking with her today, because her fight is not over. Her children are still connected to the man who trafficked her. And now, Sara is fighting to bring them to safety. Fighting to break the cycle for good. And she is not alone.
---
Friend, maybe this is your first time hearing about us. The **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists for one reason: **_To stop the sale of God 's children._** We were born from the true story told in the film _Sound of Freedom, _but this mission did not end when the credits rolled. It became a movement. Today, we work around the world to **prevent trafficking before it starts. ****We support partners that help rescue children in danger, support survivors on their long road to healing, and fight for laws that protect the innocent.**

But restoration. A future rebuilt. **You see, Friend, **Sound of Freedom Foundation 's** mission is simple: **_To stop the sale of God 's children._** We extend the reach of the _Sound of Freedom_ film, shining a light on how real and widespread child trafficking is and what we must do to stop it.

**We believe in a future where this evil is gone. ****_A world where every child is safe and truly free._** Jesus said, _" Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me."_ (Matthew 18:5) **Today you have the chance to be part of that welcome and**** be part of that light.**

clean_body: You can help stop this| | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend,She was just a child. And the person who should have protected her was the one who first trafficked her. Her own mother. What began there didn't stop. She was sold again and again. Passed between people who saw her as an object. Not a child. Not a life. Not someone worth protecting. As the years went on, the trauma only grew deeper. To survive, she turned to addiction \- the only way to numb the pain. The only way to keep going. She even had children with one of the men who trafficked her. Another chain and reason it felt impossible to escape. For years, she lived in fear. No way out. Until one day, she reached a breaking point. With nothing but courage and fear in her heart, she ran, fleeing to a women's shelter. No plan. No safety. Just hope that maybe someone would help her. And that is when everything began to change. Because someone did show up. A partner of the Sound of Freedom Foundation called House Parent Project. They didn't turn her away. They didn't question her worth. They sat with her, they listened and believed her. And in that moment, light entered her story. They helped her take the next step.Then the next. And the next. They safely relocated her far from the people who had controlled her life. For the first time in years, she could breathe. She could begin to heal. But they didn't stop there. They are still walking with her today, because her fight is not over. Her children are still connected to the man who trafficked her. And now, Sara is fighting to bring them to safety. Fighting to break the cycle for good. And she is not alone. Friend, maybe this is your first time hearing about us. The Sound of Freedom Foundation exists for one reason: To stop the sale of God 's children. We were born from the true story told in the film Sound of Freedom, but this mission did not end when the credits rolled. It became a movement. Today, we work around the world to prevent trafficking before it starts. We support partners that help rescue children in danger, support survivors on their long road to healing, and fight for laws that protect the innocent. Because rescue is only the beginning. Children need safety, healing and someone to walk with them on the long road ahead. And that is what your support makes possible. Not just escape. But restoration. A future rebuilt. You see, Friend, Sound of Freedom Foundation 's mission is simple: To stop the sale of God 's children. We extend the reach of the Sound of Freedom film, shining a light on how real and widespread child trafficking is and what we must do to stop it. We believe in a future where this evil is gone. A world where every child is safe and truly free. Jesus said, " Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me." (Matthew 18:5) Today you have the chance to be part of that welcome and be part of that light. Your gift today can help: $25 -- Support immediate outreach and response $50 -- Provide critical care and stabilization $75 -- Help relocate and protect a survivor $100 -- Support ongoing care and legal advocacy Because healing takes time. Protection takes people. And freedom takes courage from all of us. You can step in and help rewrite stories like Sara's. Please give as generously as you can today. And please pray... For Sara. For her children. And for every child still waiting for someone to show up. Because God 's children are not for sale. And together... we will not stop fighting for them. For God's Children, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Happy Monday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update. Thank you for everything you've done to help build our campaign. Every conversation our volunteers have helps us build the momentum we need to get over the finish line. Below, you’ll see what Tom has been up to and find updates from the campaign and ways you can help us connect with voters across the district. Together, we’ll continue putting in the work necessary to WIN this November. Thank you for being part of the team, we're glad you're with us! | | | | | | | ✅ Tom Kean Secures Almost $18 Million for NJ-07 ✅ | | Tom recently announced that 18 Community Project Funding requests from his office were included in House funding bills. This comes out to nearly $18 million returned to the District - check out the graphic below to see the projects! “I fought to bring this federal funding home to New Jersey because our communities deserve a strong return on the tax dollars they send to Washington. These investments will improve roads and bridges, modernize water infrastructure, strengthen public safety, support our first responders, and help towns complete critical projects without placing the full burden on local property taxpayers.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | Tom has been busy on the campaign trail since our last update! He visited the Warren County Farmers' Fair, the Bedminster Farmers Market, and the Raritan Borough Street Fair, where he had the opportunity to meet with residents and local businesses. He also stopped by Morris County GOP Headquarters to rally volunteers before joining local candidates in Wharton to knock on doors and talk to voters. Our volunteers have hit the ground running, canvassing all six counties in NJ-07 and attending weekly phone banks at county offices. This past week, we have had door knocking teams in Alpha, Berkeley Heights, Bernardsville, Branchburg, Bridgewater, Clark, Greenwich, Hopatcong, Lebanon Twp., Lopatcong, Mendham Borough, Mount Olive, Roxbury, Scotch Plains, Westfield, andWharton. Want to join us? Use the SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER button below and details will be provided. Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | | | | | | | | | Spotlight of the Week | | | | This week, we're excited to introduce the 2026 Women for Kean Coalition! This outstanding team is helping engage women across the District, grow our grassroots efforts, and build the momentum needed to get over the finish line in November. A special thank you to our Coalition Chairs, Janice and Rhonda , along with our County Co-Chairs: Bonnie (Hunterdon), Amanda (Morris), Cathy (Somerset), Rachel (Sussex), Sharyn (Union), and Nancy (Warren), for their leadership and commitment to the campaign! | | | | | Tom In The News | | "" | | | | | RESERVE A TOM KEAN LAWN SIGN | | | | | | | | | Get Involved | | : Join our team and help spread our message in the community. : Your contributions power our grassroots efforts and make a difference. mailto:Isabella@TomKean.com "Isabella@TomKean.com": The Kean for Congress Team is looking for dedicated and responsible high school and college age Republicans that are interested in a campaign internship. This is a great way to learn the ins and outs of campaign-style politics and have a true on-the-job campaign experience. We can also offer college credits and signing service hours. Spread the Word: Share our updates on social media and encourage others to join our movement. | | Follow #TeamKean on Social Media! Help us spread the word! If you're not already doing so, please follow us and share our channels with a friend. | | | | | Thank you all again for being part of this team. Together, we will win Republican seats up and down the ticket and get Tom over the finish line! | | Thank you, Isabella KovarCampaign ManagerKean for Congress | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Tom Kean Jr. is the proud husband to Rhonda, and the proud father to two daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful town of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom’s dedication and commitment to public service was inspired at a young age by his grandfather who served in the U.S. House of Representatives, and his father who served as Governor of New Jersey. Throughout Tom’s life, he has followed in their footsteps while setting forth his own path of public service—now serving as a first-term Congressman for New Jersey’s 7th District. Kean's mission is simple: For New Jersey. For America. For All Of Us. Last cycle, NJ-07 was one of the KEY districts responsible for flipping the House from Democrat Rule.
